title.zh: 卷一百〇三 志第五十六 禮六
title.raw: 卷一百〇三 志第五十六 禮六 Volume 103 Treatises 56: Rites 6

sentences.zh: 朝日夕月九宮貴神高禖大火壽星靈星風伯雨師司寒蠟七祀馬祖酺神

translations.literal: Morning Sun, Evening Moon, Nine Palaces Honored Spirits, High Matchmaker, Great Fire, Longevity Star, Spirit Star, Wind Lord, Rain Master, Cold Official, Wax, Seven Sacrifices, Horse Ancestor, Feast Spirit
translations.idiomatic: Morning Sun and Evening Moon; the Nine Palaces Honored Spirits; the High Matchmaker, Great Fire, Longevity Star, Spirit Star, Wind Lord, Rain Master, Cold Official, Wax Sacrifice, Seven Sacrifices, Horse Ancestor, and Feast Spirit

sentences.zh: 朝日，夕月。

translations.literal: Morning Sun, Evening Moon.
translations.idiomatic: Morning Sun and Evening Moon.

sentences.zh: 慶曆，用羊、豕各二，籩豆十二，簠、簋、俎二。

translations.literal: During Qingli, used two sheep and two pigs each, twelve biandou, two each of fu, gui, and zu.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Qingli regulations, each rite employed two sheep and two pigs, twelve baskets and stands, and two each of grain vessels and sacrificial tables.

sentences.zh: 天禧初，太常禮院以監察御史王博文言，詳定：「准禮，春分朝日于東郊，秋分夕月於西郊。

translations.literal: Early in Tianxi, the Court of Imperial Sacrifices in the Ministry of Rites, following Supervising Censor Wang Bowen's statement, examined and determined: "According to the rites, at the spring equinox worship the sun at the eastern suburbs; at the autumn equinox worship the moon at the western suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Tianxi era, the Court of Imperial Sacrifices in the Ministry of Rites, acting on a memorial from Supervising Censor Wang Bowen, examined the matter and ruled: "By canonical rite, the sun is worshipped at the eastern suburbs at the spring equinox, and the moon at the western suburbs at the autumn equinox.

sentences.zh: 《國語》：'太采朝日，少采夕月。

translations.literal: The Discourses of the States states: 'At great brightness worship the sun; at lesser brightness worship the moon.
translations.idiomatic: The Discourses of the States reads: "At great brightness one worships the sun; at lesser brightness one worships the moon."

sentences.zh: '又曰：'春朝朝日，秋夕夕月。

translations.literal: 'It also says: 'In spring worship the sun at dawn; in autumn worship the moon at dusk.
translations.idiomatic: It also says: "In spring worship the sun at dawn; in autumn worship the moon at dusk."

sentences.zh: '唐柳宗元論云：'夕之名者，朝拜之偶也。

translations.literal: 'The Tang writer Liu Zongyuan wrote in his discourse: 'The word "xi" (evening) is the counterpart of "zhao" (morning).
translations.idiomatic: Tang writer Liu Zongyuan argued in an essay: "The term 'evening' (xi) is the counterpart of 'morning' (zhao)."

sentences.zh: 古者旦見曰朝，暮見曰夕。

translations.literal: In antiquity, what one saw at dawn was called morning; what one saw at dusk was called evening.
translations.idiomatic: In antiquity, what appeared at dawn was called morning, and what appeared at dusk was called evening.

sentences.zh: '按禮，秋分夕月。

translations.literal: Examining the rites, at the autumn equinox worship the moon at evening.
translations.idiomatic: According to the rites, the moon is worshipped at evening during the autumn equinox.

sentences.zh: 蓋其時晝夜平分，太陽當午而陰魄已生，遂行夕拜之祭以祀月。

translations.literal: Presumably because at that season day and night are equally divided, the sun is at noon while the yin soul is already born, and so the evening-veneration sacrifice is performed to worship the moon.
translations.idiomatic: Presumably this is because at that season day and night are equally divided: the sun stands at noon while the yin principle has already begun to arise, and so the ceremony of evening veneration is carried out to worship the moon.

sentences.zh: 未前十刻，太官令率宰人割牲，未後三刻行禮，蓋是古禮以夕行朝祭之儀。

translations.literal: Before the tenth quarter-hour of wei, the Director of the Imperial Kitchen leads the butchers to slaughter the victims; after the third quarter-hour of wei the rite is performed — presumably because the ancient rite used the evening to conduct the ceremony of morning worship.
translations.idiomatic: Before the tenth quarter-hour of the wei period, the Director of the Imperial Kitchen leads the butchers in slaughtering the victims; the rite is performed after the third quarter-hour of wei — presumably because the ancient ceremony used the evening hours to perform what was essentially a morning-worship rite.

sentences.zh: 又按禮云：從子至巳為陽，從午至亥為陰。

translations.literal: Examining the rites further, it says: from zi to si is yang; from wu to hai is yin.
translations.idiomatic: The rites further state that the hours from zi to si belong to yang, and those from wu to hai to yin.

sentences.zh: 參詳典禮，合於未後三刻行禮。」

translations.literal: Comparing with the canonical rites, it is appropriate to perform the ceremony after the third quarter-hour of wei."
translations.idiomatic: On comparison with the canonical rites, it is proper to perform the ceremony after the third quarter-hour of wei."

sentences.zh: 皇祐五年，定朝日壇，舊高七尺，東西六步一尺五寸；

translations.literal: In Huangyou year 5, the Morning Sun altar was fixed — formerly seven chi high, six bu one chi five cun east to west;
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Huangyou, the Morning Sun altar was standardized. Formerly it had been seven chi high and six bu one chi five cun from east to west;

sentences.zh: 增為八尺，廣四丈，如唐《郊祀錄》。

translations.literal: increased to eight chi high, four zhang wide, following the Tang Record of Suburban Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: it was now raised to eight chi in height and four zhang in width, following the Tang Record of Suburban Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 夕月壇與隋、唐制度不合，從舊則壇小，如唐則坎深。

translations.literal: The Evening Moon altar did not conform to Sui and Tang institutions; following the old standard the altar was small, following Tang the pit was deep.
translations.idiomatic: The Evening Moon altar did not conform to Sui and Tang practice: under the old standard the altar was too small, while under the Tang standard the pit was too deep.

sentences.zh: 今定坎深三尺，廣四丈。

translations.literal: Now fixed: pit depth three chi, width four zhang.
translations.idiomatic: It was now fixed at a pit three chi deep and four zhang wide.

sentences.zh: 壇高一尺，廣二丈。

translations.literal: Altar height one chi, width two zhang.
translations.idiomatic: The altar itself was one chi high and two zhang wide.

sentences.zh: 四方為陛，降入坎深，然後升壇。

translations.literal: On all four sides were steps; one descends into the deep pit, then ascends the altar.
translations.idiomatic: Steps were placed on all four sides; worshippers descended into the deep pit and then ascended the altar.

sentences.zh: 壇皆兩壝，壝皆二十五步。

translations.literal: Both altars have two enclosures; each enclosure is twenty-five bu.
translations.idiomatic: Both altars were given double enclosures, each twenty-five bu in extent.

sentences.zh: 增大明、夜明壇山罍二，籩豆十二。

translations.literal: Added to the Great Brightness and Night Brightness altars two mountain lei, twelve biandou.
translations.idiomatic: To the Great Brightness and Night Brightness altars were added two mountain wine vessels and twelve baskets and stands.

sentences.zh: 禮生引司天監官分獻，上香，奠幣、爵，再拜。

translations.literal: Ritual acolytes lead officials of the Directorate of Astronomy to present separate offerings, offer incense, present silks and wine cups, and bow twice.
translations.idiomatic: Ritual acolytes lead officials of the Directorate of Astronomy in making separate offerings: they burn incense, present silks and libation cups, and bow twice.

sentences.zh: 嘉祐加羊、豕各五。

translations.literal: During Jiayou, added five sheep and five pigs each.
translations.idiomatic: During the Jiayou era, five sheep and five pigs were added to each rite.

sentences.zh: 《五禮新儀》定二壇高廣、坎深如皇祐，無所改。

translations.literal: The New Rites of the Five Sacrifices fixed the height, width, and pit depth of both altars as in Huangyou, with no changes.
translations.idiomatic: The New Rites of the Five Sacrifices confirmed the height, width, and pit depth of both altars as established in Huangyou, without further alteration.

sentences.zh: 中興同。

translations.literal: During the Restoration, the same.
translations.idiomatic: After the dynastic restoration, the same arrangements held.

sentences.zh: 太一九宮神位，在國門之東郊。

translations.literal: The Taiyi Nine Palaces spirit seats were at the eastern suburbs outside the capital gate.
translations.idiomatic: The spirit seats of Taiyi and the Nine Palaces stood in the eastern suburbs outside the capital gate.

sentences.zh: 壇之制，四陛外，西南又為一陛，曰坤道，俾行事者升降由之。

translations.literal: As for the altar's structure, besides the four sets of steps on the sides, on the southwest another set of steps was made, called the Kun Way, by which those conducting the rites ascend and descend.
translations.idiomatic: The altar was laid out with four stepped ramps on the cardinal sides; on the southwest a fifth ramp, called the Kun Way, was added so that those conducting the rite could ascend and descend by it.

sentences.zh: 其九宮神壇再成，第一成東西南北各百二十尺，再成東西南北各一百尺，俱高三尺。

translations.literal: The Nine Palaces spirit altar had two tiers; the first tier was one hundred twenty chi on each side east, south, west, and north; the second tier one hundred chi on each side; all three chi high.
translations.idiomatic: The Nine Palaces spirit altar rose in two tiers: the lower tier measured one hundred twenty chi on each side, the upper one hundred chi, and both tiers stood three chi high.

sentences.zh: 壇上置小壇九，每壇高一尺五寸，縱廣八尺，各相去一丈六尺。

translations.literal: On the altar were placed nine small altars; each small altar was one chi five cun high, eight chi long and wide, and separated from the next by one zhang six chi.
translations.idiomatic: Nine small altars were set upon the main altar, each one chi five cun high and eight chi square, spaced one zhang six chi apart.

sentences.zh: 初用中祀，咸平中改為大祀，壇增兩壝，玉用兩圭有邸，藉用稿秸加褥如幣色，其禦書祝禮如社稷。

translations.literal: Initially medium sacrifice was used; in Xianping it was changed to great sacrifice; the altar gained two enclosures; jade used was two gui with base; matting used straw with padding matching silk colors; imperial calligraphy and prayer rites were like those for the Soil and Grain.
translations.idiomatic: At first a medium sacrifice was performed; in the Xianping era it was raised to a great sacrifice. Two enclosures were added to the altar; jade offerings took the form of paired gui with base; straw matting with colored cushions matching the silks was used; and the imperial prayer text followed the precedent of the Soil and Grain rites.

sentences.zh: 尋以封禪，別建九宮壇泰山下行宮之東，壇二成，成一尺，面各長五丈二尺，四陛及坤道各廣五丈。

translations.literal: Soon, because of the feng and shan sacrifices, a separate Nine Palaces altar was built east of the traveling palace below Mount Tai; the altar had two tiers, one chi per tier, each face five zhang two chi long; the four sets of steps and the Kun Way were each five zhang wide.
translations.idiomatic: When the feng and shan sacrifices were undertaken, a separate Nine Palaces altar was erected east of the imperial traveling palace at the foot of Mount Tai. It rose in two tiers of one chi each, with each face five zhang two chi long; the four stepped ramps and the Kun Way were each five zhang wide.

sentences.zh: 上九小壇，相去各八尺，四隅各留五尺。

translations.literal: Above were nine small altars, each separated by eight chi; at the four corners five chi were left open.
translations.idiomatic: Nine small altars stood on top, eight chi apart, with five chi left open at each corner.

sentences.zh: 壇下兩壝，依大祠禮。

translations.literal: Below the altar were two enclosures, following the rites of great sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: Below the altar were double enclosures, laid out according to the rites of great sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 及祀汾陰，亦遣使祀焉。

translations.literal: When sacrifices were offered at Fen-yin, envoys were also dispatched to worship there.
translations.idiomatic: When sacrifices were offered at Fen-yin, envoys were likewise dispatched to worship at this altar.

sentences.zh: 自後親郊恭謝，皆遣官於本壇別祭。

translations.literal: Thereafter, whenever the emperor performed suburban sacrifice and the thanksgiving rite in person, officials were dispatched to perform separate sacrifices at this altar.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter, whenever the emperor performed the suburban sacrifice and the thanksgiving rite in person, officials were sent to offer separate sacrifices at this altar.

sentences.zh: 景祐二年，學士章得象等定司天監生於淵、役人單訓所請祀九宮太一依逐年飛移位次之法：「案郤良遇《九宮法》，有《飛棋立成圖》，每歲一移，推九州所主災福事。

translations.literal: In Jingyou year 2, Academician Zhang Dexiang and others determined, at the request of Directorate of Astronomy student Yu Yuan and laborer Shan Xun, that worship of the Nine Palaces Taiyi should follow the method of yearly flying-position relocation: "Examining Xi Liangyu's Nine Palaces Method, there is a Flying Chess Instant Determination Chart; it shifts once each year, to calculate which of the nine regions presides over fortune and disaster.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Jingyou, Academician Zhang Dexiang and his colleagues, responding to a petition from Directorate of Astronomy student Yu Yuan and laborer Shan Xun, ruled that worship of the Nine Palaces Taiyi should follow the method of yearly flying-position relocation: "According to Xi Liangyu's Nine Palaces Method, there is a Flying Chess Instant Determination Chart that shifts once each year to determine which of the nine regions governs fortune and calamity.

sentences.zh: 又唐術士蘇嘉慶始置九宮神壇，一成，高三尺，四陛。

translations.literal: Also, the Tang technomancer Su Jiaqing first established the Nine Palaces spirit altar: one tier, three chi high, four sets of steps.
translations.idiomatic: The Tang technomancer Su Jiaqing had first established the Nine Palaces spirit altar as a single tier three chi high, with four stepped ramps.

sentences.zh: 上依位次置九小壇：東南曰招搖，正東曰軒轅，東北曰太陰，正南曰天一，中央曰天符，北曰太一，西南曰攝提，正西曰咸池，西北曰青龍。

translations.literal: Above, nine small altars were placed according to positional order: southeast called Zhaoyao, due east Xuan Yuan, northeast Tai Yin, due south Tian Yi, center Tian Fu, north Tai Yi, southwest She Ti, due west Xian Chi, northwest Qing Long.
translations.idiomatic: Nine small altars were arranged upon it according to fixed positions: southeast, Zhaoyao; due east, Xuan Yuan; northeast, Great Yin; due south, Heaven One; center, Heaven Talisman; north, Great Unity; southwest, Sheti; due west, Salt Pool; northwest, Azure Dragon.

sentences.zh: 五數為中，戴九履一，左三右七，二四為上，六八為下，符於遁甲，此則九宮定位。

translations.literal: Five as center — head wears nine, feet tread one, three on the left and seven on the right, two and four above, six and eight below — matching Dunjia; this is the fixed positioning of the Nine Palaces.
translations.idiomatic: With five at the center — nine worn on the head, one trodden underfoot, three to the left and seven to the right, two and four above, six and eight below — the arrangement conforms to the Hidden Stems method; this is the fixed positioning of the Nine Palaces.

sentences.zh: 歲祭以四孟，隨歲改位行棋，謂之飛位。

translations.literal: Annual sacrifice in the four first months of the seasons; with each year the positions on the chess board shift — this is called flying positions.
translations.idiomatic: Sacrifice was offered in the first month of each season; with each year the positions on the chess board shifted — a practice called flying positions.

sentences.zh: 自乾元以後，止依本位祭之，遂不飛易，仍減冬、夏二祭。

translations.literal: After the Qianyuan era, worship was offered only at fixed positions, and flying shifts ceased; the winter and summer sacrifices were also reduced.
translations.idiomatic: After the Qianyuan era worship was confined to fixed positions, the flying shifts were abandoned, and the winter and summer sacrifices were dropped.

sentences.zh: 國朝因之。

translations.literal: Our dynasty followed this.
translations.idiomatic: The Song followed this practice.

sentences.zh: 今於淵等所請，合天寶初祭之理，又合良遇《飛棋之圖》。

translations.literal: Now regarding the request of Yu and others, it accords with the rationale of the Tianbao-era initial sacrifices, and also accords with Liangyu's Flying Chess Chart.
translations.idiomatic: The petition of Yu and his colleagues aligns both with the reasoning behind the initial Tianbao sacrifices and with Liangyu's Flying Chess Chart.

sentences.zh: 然其法本術家，時祭之文經禮不載。

translations.literal: However, the method originates with technomancers; the texts for seasonal sacrifices are not recorded in canonical rites.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the method itself originates among technomancers, and the rites for seasonal sacrifice are not recorded in the canonical ritual texts.

sentences.zh: 議者或謂不必飛宮，若日月星辰躔次周流而祭有常所，此則定位之祀所當從也。

translations.literal: Some debaters hold that flying palaces need not be used; if the sun, moon, stars, and constellations move in their cycles while sacrifice has a fixed place, then fixed-position worship is what ought to be followed.
translations.idiomatic: Some argued that the flying palace need not be employed: just as the sun, moon, stars, and constellations wheel through their courses while sacrifice has a fixed abode, fixed-position worship is what ought to be observed.

sentences.zh: 若其推數於回復，候神於恍忽，因方弭沴，隨氣考祥，則飛位之文固可遵用。

translations.literal: If one calculates numbers at cycles of return, awaits spirits in vagueness, pacifies calamities by direction, and examines auspices through qi, then the flying-position texts can indeed be followed.
translations.idiomatic: But if one calculates at the turning points of cosmic cycles, awaits the spirits in the realm between presence and absence, quiets calamity according to directional correspondence, and reads omens through the movements of qi, then the flying-position rites may properly be followed.

sentences.zh: 請依唐禮，遇祭九宮之時，遣司天監一員詣祠所，隨每年貴神飛棋之方，旋定祭位。

translations.literal: Request to follow Tang rites: when worshipping the Nine Palaces, dispatch one official of the Directorate of Astronomy to the sacrificial site, following each year's honored spirit flying-chess direction, to determine the sacrificial position on the spot.
translations.idiomatic: It was proposed that Tang practice be followed: whenever the Nine Palaces were worshipped, one official of the Directorate of Astronomy should be sent to the sacrificial site to fix the altar position according to the direction indicated by that year's honored spirit on the flying-chess chart.

sentences.zh: 仍自天聖己巳入曆，太一在一宮，歲進一位，飛棋巡行，周而復始。」

translations.literal: Further, beginning from Tiansheng jisi entering the calendar, Taiyi occupies one palace and advances one position each year; the flying chess circulates, and when the circuit is complete it begins anew."
translations.idiomatic: Beginning from the jisi year of Tiansheng as the entry point in the calendar, Great Unity would occupy one palace and advance one position each year; the flying chess would make its rounds, and when the circuit was complete would begin again."

sentences.zh: 詔可。

translations.literal: Edict approved.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor assented.

sentences.zh: 慶曆儀，每坐籩、豆十二，簠、簋、俎二。

translations.literal: Qingli rites: each seat twelve biandou, two each of fu, gui, and zu.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Qingli regulations, each seat received twelve baskets and stands and two each of grain vessels and sacrificial tables.

sentences.zh: 皇祐增壇三成。

translations.literal: Huangyou increased the altar to three tiers.
translations.idiomatic: In Huangyou the altar was raised to three tiers.

sentences.zh: 又禮官言：「歲雩祀外，水旱稍久，皆遣官告天地、宗廟、社稷及諸寺觀、宮廟，九宮貴神今列大祀，亦宜准此。」

translations.literal: Also ritual officials said: "Besides the annual rain-prayer sacrifice, whenever drought or flood persists for some time, officials are dispatched to announce to Heaven and Earth, the ancestral temples, the Soil and Grain, and the various temples and shrines; the Nine Palaces Honored Spirits are now ranked as great sacrifice, and ought to follow this standard as well."
translations.idiomatic: Ritual officials further observed: "Apart from the annual rain-prayer sacrifice, whenever drought or flood endures for any length of time, officials are dispatched to announce the calamity to Heaven and Earth, the ancestral temples, the Soil and Grain, and the various temples and shrines. The Nine Palaces Honored Spirits are now classed as a great sacrifice and ought to be included in this practice."

sentences.zh: 熙甯四年，司天中官正周琮言：「《太一經》推算，七年甲寅歲，太一陽九、百六之數，復元之初。

translations.literal: Xining year 4, middle-ranking official of the Directorate of Astronomy Zhou Cong said: "Calculating from the Classic of Great Unity, in the seventh year of the sexagenary cycle, the year jiayin, the numbers of Taiyi yang-nine and bai-liu reach the beginning of return to origin.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Xining, Zhou Cong, a middle-ranking official of the Directorate of Astronomy, reported: "According to calculations in the Classic of Great Unity, in the seventh year of the sexagenary cycle — the year jiayin — the yang-nine and hundred-six numbers of Great Unity arrive at the threshold of cosmic renewal.

sentences.zh: 故《經》言：'太歲有陽九之災，太一有百六之厄，皆在入元之初終。

translations.literal: Therefore the Classic says: 'When the Grand Year has yang-nine disaster, Taiyi has bai-liu calamity — both occur at the beginning and end of entering origin.
translations.idiomatic: The Classic therefore states: "When the Grand Year bears the disaster of yang-nine and Great Unity the calamity of hundred-six, both fall at the opening and closing of a cosmic cycle."

sentences.zh: '今陽九、百六當癸丑、甲寅歲，為災厄之會。

translations.literal: Now yang-nine and bai-liu fall in the guichou and jiayin years — a confluence of disaster and calamity.
translations.idiomatic: The yang-nine and hundred-six periods now coincide with the guichou and jiayin years — a confluence of disaster and calamity.

sentences.zh: 然五福太一移入中都，可以消異為祥。

translations.literal: However, the Five Blessings Taiyi moves into the central capital, and can transform anomalies into auspice.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the Five Blessings Great Unity is moving into the central capital, and may turn misfortune into blessing.

sentences.zh: 竊詳五福太一，自國朝雍熙元年甲申歲，入東南巽宮時，修東太一宮。

translations.literal: Examining in detail the Five Blessings Taiyi: from our dynasty's Yongxi year 1 jiashen, when it entered the southeast Xun palace, the Eastern Taiyi Palace was built.
translations.idiomatic: Precedent confirms this for the Five Blessings Great Unity: when in the first year of Yongxi, the jiashen year, it entered the southeast Xun palace, the Eastern Taiyi Palace was built.

sentences.zh: 天聖七年己巳歲，五福太一入西南坤位，修西太一宮。

translations.literal: Tiansheng year 7 jisi, Five Blessings Taiyi entered the southwest Kun position; the Western Taiyi Palace was built.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of Tiansheng, the jisi year, when the Five Blessings Great Unity entered the southwest Kun position, the Western Taiyi Palace was built.

sentences.zh: 請稽詳故事，崇建祠宇，迎之京師。」

translations.literal: Request to examine precedents in detail, honorably build shrine halls, and welcome it to the capital.'
translations.idiomatic: We ask that precedents be carefully reviewed, a shrine hall be fittingly erected, and the deity be welcomed to the capital."

sentences.zh: 詔建中太一宮於集禧觀。

translations.literal: Edict: build the Central Taiyi Palace at Jixi Guan.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the Central Taiyi Palace built within Jixi Guan.

sentences.zh: 十太一神，並用通天冠、絳紗袍。

translations.literal: The ten Taiyi spirits all used the Tongtian crown and crimson gauze robe.
translations.idiomatic: Images of the ten Taiyi spirits were all vested with the Tongtian crown and crimson gauze robe.

sentences.zh: 元豐中，太常博士何洵直言：「熙寧祀儀，九宮貴神祝文稱'嗣天子臣某'，以禮秩論之，當與社稷為比，請依祀儀為大祀。

translations.literal: During Yuanfeng, Court of Imperial Sacrifices Doctor He Xunzhi said: "Under the Xining sacrificial rites, the Nine Palaces Honored Spirits prayer text reads 'successor Son of Heaven, subject So-and-so'; measured by ritual rank, this should be compared with the Soil and Grain; request to follow the sacrificial rites as great sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: During the Yuanfeng era, He Xunzhi, a doctor of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, argued: "Under the Xining sacrificial code, the prayer text for the Nine Palaces Honored Spirits reads 'successor Son of Heaven, subject So-and-so.' By ritual rank this worship should be equated with the Soil and Grain rites; I ask that it be confirmed as a great sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 其祝版即依會昌故事及《開寶通禮》，書禦名不稱臣。

translations.literal: The prayer tablet should follow Huichang precedents and the Comprehensive Rites of Kaibao, writing the imperial name without calling oneself subject.
translations.idiomatic: The prayer tablet should follow Huichang precedent and the Comprehensive Rites of Kaibao, bearing the imperial name alone and omitting the self-designation as subject.

sentences.zh: 又近制，諸祠祭牲數，正配以全體解割，各用一牢，貴神九位悉是正坐，異壇別祝，尊為大祝，而共用二少牢，於腥熟之俎，骨體不備。

translations.literal: Also, under recent regulations on sacrificial livestock: principal and associate pairs receive whole-body dissection, each using one lao; all nine Honored Spirit seats are principal seats; separate altars and separate prayers; ranked as great prayer; yet jointly they use two shao-lao; in the raw and cooked zu stands, bones and flesh are incomplete.
translations.idiomatic: Under recent regulations governing sacrificial livestock, principal and associate pairs each receive a whole victim carved in the standard manner, one full sacrifice per pair. All nine Honored Spirit seats are principal seats, each with its own altar and prayer and ranked as a great prayer — yet together they share only two lesser sacrifices, so that the raw and cooked offerings on the sacrificial stands lack complete bones and flesh.

sentences.zh: 謂宜每位一牢，凡九少牢。」

translations.literal: It is proposed that each seat should have one lao — nine shao-lao in all."
translations.idiomatic: Each seat ought to receive one sacrifice of its own — nine lesser sacrifices in all."

sentences.zh: 詔下太常，修入祀儀。

translations.literal: Edict sent down to the Court of Imperial Sacrifices; revise and incorporate into the sacrificial rites.
translations.idiomatic: An edict was sent to the Court of Imperial Sacrifices directing that the code be revised accordingly.

sentences.zh: 元祐七年，監察御史安鼎言：「按漢武帝始祠太一一位，唐天寶初兼祀八宮，謂之九宮貴神。

translations.literal: Yuanyou year 7, Supervising Censor An Ding said: "Examining the matter — Emperor Wu of Han first worshipped Taiyi in one position; early in Tang Tianbao the eight palaces were also worshipped, and these were called the Nine Palaces Honored Spirits.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of Yuanyou, Supervising Censor An Ding argued: "Emperor Wu of Han first worshipped Great Unity in a single position; early in the Tang Tianbao era the eight palaces were added, and the whole was called the Nine Palaces Honored Spirits.

sentences.zh: 漢祀太一，日用一犢，凡七日而止。

translations.literal: Han worship of Taiyi used one calf daily, stopping after seven days in all.
translations.idiomatic: In Han times worship of Great Unity required one calf each day, for seven days in all.

sentences.zh: 唐祀類於天地。

translations.literal: Tang worship was similar to that of Heaven and Earth.
translations.idiomatic: Tang worship resembled that offered to Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 今春秋祀九宮太一，用羊、豕，其四立祭太一宮十神，皆無牲，以素饌加酒焉。

translations.literal: Now in spring and autumn the Nine Palaces Taiyi is worshipped with sheep and pigs; the four seasonal sacrifices at the Taiyi Palace to the ten spirits use no livestock, only plain offerings with wine.
translations.idiomatic: Today the Nine Palaces Great Unity receives sheep and pigs in spring and autumn, yet the four seasonal sacrifices at the Taiyi Palace to the ten spirits employ no livestock — only plain food with wine.

sentences.zh: 再詳《星經》：太一一星在紫宮門右，天一之南，號曰天之貴神。

translations.literal: Examining further the Classic of Stars: Taiyi is one star to the right of the Purple Palace gate, south of Tian Yi, called Heaven's Honored Spirit.
translations.idiomatic: The Classic of Stars further records that Great Unity is a single star to the right of the Purple Palace gate, south of Heaven One, styled Heaven's Honored Spirit.

sentences.zh: 其佐曰五帝，飛行諸方，躡三能以上下，以天極星其一明者為常居。

translations.literal: Its assistants are the Five Emperors, flying through the regions, treading above the Three Powers up and down; the brightest of the Celestial Pole stars is the permanent abode.
translations.idiomatic: Its assistants are the Five Emperors, who traverse the directions and move above and below the Three Powers; of the stars at the Celestial Pole, the brightest is their permanent seat.

sentences.zh: 主使十六神，知風雨、水旱、兵革、饑饉、疫疾、災害之事。

translations.literal: It commands sixteen spirits, knowing matters of wind and rain, drought and flood, war, famine, pestilence, and disaster.
translations.idiomatic: It commands sixteen attendant spirits and governs wind and rain, drought and flood, war, famine, pestilence, and every form of calamity.

sentences.zh: 《唐書》曰：'九宮貴神，實司水旱。

translations.literal: The History of Tang says: 'The Nine Palaces Honored Spirits truly govern drought and flood.
translations.idiomatic: The History of Tang states: "The Nine Palaces Honored Spirits truly preside over drought and flood."

sentences.zh: 太一掌十六神之法度，以輔人極。

translations.literal: Taiyi presides over the law of the sixteen spirits, to assist the human ultimate.
translations.idiomatic: Great Unity holds authority over the sixteen spirits and supports the human pole of existence.

sentences.zh: '《國朝會要》亦云：'天之尊神及十精、十六度，並主風雨。

translations.literal: 'The Song Statecraft Essentials also says: 'Heaven's supreme spirit, the ten essences, and the sixteen degrees all govern wind and rain.
translations.idiomatic: The Song Statecraft Essentials likewise records: "Heaven's supreme spirit, the ten essences, and the sixteen degrees all govern wind and rain."

sentences.zh: '由是觀之，十神太一、九宮太一與漢所祀太一共是一神。

translations.literal: From this view, the ten-spirit Taiyi, the Nine Palaces Taiyi, and the Taiyi worshipped in Han are one spirit.
translations.idiomatic: From this it would seem that the ten-spirit Great Unity, the Nine Palaces Great Unity, and the Great Unity worshipped in Han are one and the same deity.

sentences.zh: 今十神皆用素饌，而九宮並薦羊豕，似非禮意。」

translations.literal: Now the ten spirits all use plain offerings, while the Nine Palaces all offer sheep and pigs — this seems not the intent of the rites.'
translations.idiomatic: Yet the ten spirits now receive only plain offerings while the Nine Palaces receive sheep and pigs — an arrangement that seems inconsistent with ritual intent."

sentences.zh: 詔禮官詳定：十神、九宮太一各有所主，即非一神，故自唐迄今皆用牲牢，別無祠壇用素食禮。

translations.literal: Edict: ritual officials examine and determine — the ten-spirit and Nine Palaces Taiyi each have their own dominion; they are not one spirit; therefore from Tang to the present all use livestock; separately, no altar employs a vegetarian rite.
translations.idiomatic: An edict directed the ritual officials to examine the matter. They ruled that the ten-spirit and Nine Palaces forms of Great Unity have distinct dominions and are not a single deity; from Tang times to the present livestock sacrifices have been standard, and no separate altar employs a vegetarian rite.

sentences.zh: 遂依舊制。

translations.literal: Accordingly the old system was followed.
translations.idiomatic: The old practice was therefore maintained.

sentences.zh: 崇寧三年，太常博士羅畸言：「九宮諸神位，無禮神玉，惟有燔玉。

translations.literal: Chongning year 3, Court of Imperial Sacrifices Doctor Luo Ji said: "The various spirit seats of the Nine Palaces have no ritual-spirit jade; there is only burnt jade.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Chongning, Luo Ji, a doctor of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, observed: "The Nine Palaces spirit seats possess no ritual-spirit jade — only jade burned in the fire.

sentences.zh: 竊謂宜用禮神玉，少仿其幣之色薦於神坐。」

translations.literal: Humbly consider — ritual-spirit jade ought to be used, slightly imitating the color of the silks presented at the spirit seat."
translations.idiomatic: I respectfully propose that ritual-spirit jade be used, its hue roughly matching the color of the silks laid before each seat."

sentences.zh: 議禮局言：「先王制禮，用圭璧以祀日月星辰，所謂圭璧者，圭，其邸為璧，以取殺於上帝也。

translations.literal: The Ritual Deliberation Bureau said: "Former kings established rites — gui and bi were used to worship the sun, moon, stars, and constellations; the so-called gui-bi means a gui whose base is a bi, to show reduction before Supreme God.
translations.idiomatic: The Ritual Deliberation Bureau replied: "The former kings ordained that gui and bi were the jades for worshipping the sun, moon, stars, and constellations. The so-called gui-bi is a gui tablet whose base is formed as a bi disc, signifying diminution before the Supreme God.

sentences.zh: 今九宮神皆星名，而其玉用兩圭有邸。

translations.literal: Now the Nine Palaces spirits are all named for stars, yet the jade used is two gui with base.
translations.idiomatic: The Nine Palaces spirits are all named for stars, yet the jade now employed is the paired gui with base.

sentences.zh: 夫兩圭有邸，祀地之玉，以祀星辰，非周禮也。

translations.literal: Two gui with base is jade for worshipping earth; to use it for stars is not Zhou rites.
translations.idiomatic: The paired gui with base is jade for worshipping earth; to offer it to stars is not Zhou ritual.

sentences.zh: 乞改用圭璧以應古制。」

translations.literal: Request to change to gui-bi to accord with the ancient system."
translations.idiomatic: We ask that gui-bi be adopted to restore the ancient standard."

sentences.zh: 《政和新儀》：「立春日祀東太一宮；

translations.literal: The New Rites of Zhenghe: "On the day of Establishment of Spring, worship the Eastern Taiyi Palace;
translations.idiomatic: The New Rites of Zhenghe specify: "On the day marking the Establishment of Spring, worship at the Eastern Taiyi Palace;

sentences.zh: 立夏、季夏土王日祀中太一宮；

translations.literal: on Start of Summer and on the Earth Sovereign day of the last summer month, worship the Central Taiyi Palace;
translations.idiomatic: on Start of Summer and on the Earth Sovereign day of the last summer month, worship at the Central Taiyi Palace;

sentences.zh: 立秋日祀西太一宮；

translations.literal: on the day of Start of Autumn, worship the Western Taiyi Palace;
translations.idiomatic: on the day marking Start of Autumn, worship at the Western Taiyi Palace;

sentences.zh: 立冬日祀中太一宮，宮之真室殿，五福太一在中，君基太一在東，太遊太一在西，俱南向。

translations.literal: on the day of Start of Winter, worship the Central Taiyi Palace — in the palace's True Chamber Hall, Five Blessings Taiyi in the center, Lord Foundation Taiyi in the east, Great Traveling Taiyi in the west, all facing south.
translations.idiomatic: on the day marking Start of Winter, worship at the Central Taiyi Palace. In the palace's True Chamber Hall, Five Blessings Great Unity stands in the center, Lord Foundation Great Unity in the east, and Great Traveling Great Unity in the west — all facing south.

sentences.zh: 延休殿，四神太一。

translations.literal: Yanxiu Hall: the four-spirit Taiyi.
translations.idiomatic: In Yanxiu Hall: the four-spirit Great Unity.

sentences.zh: 承厘殿，臣基太一在東，西向，北上。

translations.literal: Chengli Hall: Subject Foundation Taiyi in the east, facing west, north elevated.
translations.idiomatic: In Chengli Hall: Subject Foundation Great Unity in the east, facing west with the north side elevated.

sentences.zh: 凝祐殿，直符太一。

translations.literal: Ningyou Hall: Direct Talisman Taiyi.
translations.idiomatic: In Ningyou Hall: Direct Talisman Great Unity.

sentences.zh: 臻福殿，民基太一在西，東向，北上。

translations.literal: Zhenfu Hall: People Foundation Taiyi in the west, facing east, north elevated.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhenfu Hall: People Foundation Great Unity in the west, facing east with the north side elevated.

sentences.zh: 膺慶殿，小遊太一在中，天一太一在東，地一太一在西。

translations.literal: Yingqing Hall: Small Traveling Taiyi in the center, Heaven-One Taiyi in the east, Earth-One Taiyi in the west.
translations.idiomatic: In Yingqing Hall: Small Traveling Great Unity in the center, Heaven-One Great Unity in the east, Earth-One Great Unity in the west.

sentences.zh: 靈貺殿，太歲在中，太陰在西，俱南向。

translations.literal: Lingkuang Hall: Grand Year in the center, Grand Yin in the west, both facing south.
translations.idiomatic: In Lingkuang Hall: the Grand Year in the center and Grand Yin in the west, both facing south.

sentences.zh: 三皇、五方帝、日月、五星、二十八宿、十日、十二辰、天地水三官、五行、九宮、八卦、五嶽、四海、四瀆、十二山神等，並為從祀。

translations.literal: The Three Sovereigns, Five Directional Emperors, sun and moon, five planets, twenty-eight lodges, ten days, twelve hours, Heaven-Earth-Water Three Officials, Five Phases, Nine Palaces, Eight Trigrams, Five Sacred Mountains, Four Seas, Four Watercourses, twelve mountain spirits, and others — all as attendant sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: The Three Sovereigns, Five Directional Emperors, sun and moon, five planets, twenty-eight lodges, ten days, twelve double-hours, the Three Officials of Heaven, Earth, and Water, the Five Phases, Nine Palaces, Eight Trigrams, Five Sacred Mountains, Four Seas, Four Watercourses, twelve mountain spirits, and others all attend as secondary sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 東、西太一宮准此。

translations.literal: The Eastern and Western Taiyi Palaces follow this.
translations.idiomatic: The Eastern and Western Taiyi Palaces follow the same arrangement.

sentences.zh: 東太一宮大殿，五福太一在東，君基太一在西，俱南向。

translations.literal: In the Eastern Taiyi Palace main hall, Five Blessings Taiyi in the east, Lord Foundation Taiyi in the west, both facing south.
translations.idiomatic: In the main hall of the Eastern Taiyi Palace, Five Blessings Great Unity stands in the east and Lord Foundation Great Unity in the west, both facing south.

sentences.zh: 太遊太一殿在大殿之北，南向。

translations.literal: The Great Traveling Taiyi Hall is north of the main hall, facing south.
translations.idiomatic: The Hall of Great Traveling Great Unity stands north of the main hall, facing south.

sentences.zh: 臣基太一殿在南，北向。

translations.literal: The Hall of Subject Foundation Taiyi is in the south, facing north.
translations.idiomatic: The Hall of Subject Foundation Great Unity stood to the south, facing north.

sentences.zh: 小游太一、直符太一、四神太一殿在大殿之東，西向，北上。

translations.literal: The halls of Small Traveling Taiyi, Direct Talisman Taiyi, and Four Spirits Taiyi are east of the main hall, facing west, north elevated.
translations.idiomatic: The halls of Small Traveling Great Unity, Direct Talisman Great Unity, and Four Spirits Great Unity stood east of the main hall, facing west with the north side elevated.

sentences.zh: 天一太一、民基太一、地一太一在大殿之西，東向，北上。

translations.literal: Heaven-One Taiyi, People Foundation Taiyi, and Earth-One Taiyi are west of the main hall, facing east, north elevated.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven-One Great Unity, People Foundation Great Unity, and Earth-One Great Unity stood west of the main hall, facing east with the north side elevated.

sentences.zh: 西太一宮黃庭殿，五福在中，君基在東，太遊在西；

translations.literal: In the Western Taiyi Palace Huangting Hall, Five Blessings in the center, Lord Foundation in the east, Great Traveling in the west;
translations.idiomatic: In Huangting Hall of the Western Great Unity Palace, Five Blessings stood in the center, Lord Foundation in the east, and Great Traveling in the west;

sentences.zh: 均福殿，小遊在中，俱南向。

translations.literal: Junfu Hall: Small Traveling in the center; all facing south.
translations.idiomatic: In Junfu Hall, Small Traveling stood at the center; all faced south.

sentences.zh: 延貺殿，天一在中，四神在南，臣基在北，俱西向。

translations.literal: Yanbiang Hall: Heaven One in the center, Four Spirits in the south, Subject Foundation in the north; all facing west.
translations.idiomatic: In Yanbiang Hall, Heaven One stood at the center, Four Spirits to the south, and Subject Foundation to the north; all faced west.

sentences.zh: 資祐殿，地一在中，四神在南，臣基在北，俱西向。

translations.literal: Ziyou Hall: Earth One in the center, Four Spirits in the south, Subject Foundation in the north; all facing west.
translations.idiomatic: In Ziyou Hall, Earth One stood at the center, Four Spirits to the south, and Subject Foundation to the north; all faced west.

sentences.zh: 資祐殿，地一在中，民基在南，直符在東北，俱東向。」

translations.literal: Ziyou Hall: Earth One in the center, People Foundation in the south, Direct Talisman in the northeast; all facing east."
translations.idiomatic: In Ziyou Hall, Earth One stood at the center, People Foundation to the south, and Direct Talisman to the northeast; all faced east."

sentences.zh: 九宮貴神壇三成，一成縱廣十四丈，再成縱廣十二丈，三成縱廣十丈，各高三尺。

translations.literal: The Nine Palaces Honored Spirits altar has three tiers; the first tier is fourteen zhang long and wide, the second tier twelve zhang, the third tier ten zhang; each tier is three chi high.
translations.idiomatic: The altar of the Nine Palaces Honored Spirits rose in three tiers: the lowest measured fourteen zhang on each side, the middle twelve zhang, the uppermost ten zhang; each tier stood three chi high.

sentences.zh: 上依方位置小壇九，各高一尺五寸，縱廣八尺。

translations.literal: Above, nine small altars are placed according to directional positions; each is one chi five cun high, eight chi long and wide.
translations.idiomatic: Upon it, nine small altars were arranged according to their directional positions, each one chi five cun high and eight chi square.

sentences.zh: 四陛、坤道，兩壝，每壝二十五步，如舊制。

translations.literal: Four sets of steps and the Kun Way, two enclosures, each enclosure twenty-five bu, as in the old institution.
translations.idiomatic: It had four stepped ramps and the Kun Way, with double enclosures of twenty-five bu each, following the old institution.

sentences.zh: 紹興十一年，太常丞朱輅言：「九宮貴神所主風、雨、霜、雪、雹、疫，所系甚重，請舉行祀典。」

translations.literal: In Shaoxing year 11, Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Zhu Lu said: "The Nine Palaces Honored Spirits preside over wind, rain, frost, snow, hail, and pestilence; what they govern is of great weight. I request that the sacrificial canon be implemented."
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year of Shaoxing, Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Zhu Lu submitted a memorial: "The Nine Palaces Honored Spirits govern wind, rain, frost, snow, hail, and pestilence — matters of grave import. I request that the full sacrificial rites be restored."

sentences.zh: 太常寺主簿林大鼐亦言：「十神太一，九宮太一，皆天之貴神，國朝分為二，並為大祀。

translations.literal: Chief Clerk of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Lin Dainai also said: "The Ten Spirits Taiyi and the Nine Palaces Taiyi are all honored spirits of Heaven. Our dynasty has divided them into two rites, both ranked as great sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: Chief Clerk of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Lin Dainai added: "The Ten Spirits Great Unity and the Nine Palaces Great Unity are both exalted spirits of Heaven. Our dynasty has divided them into two separate rites, each ranked as a great sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 比一新太一宮，而九宮貴神尚寓屋而不壇。」

translations.literal: Recently a new Taiyi Palace was built, yet the Nine Palaces Honored Spirits are still housed in buildings rather than on an altar."
translations.idiomatic: A new Great Unity Palace has just been completed, yet the Nine Palaces Honored Spirits are still lodged in buildings rather than provided with a proper altar."

sentences.zh: 乃詔臨安府于國城之東，建築九宮壇壝，其儀如祀上帝。

translations.literal: An edict was issued ordering Lin'an Prefecture to construct the Nine Palaces altar and enclosure east of the capital, with rites like those for worshiping the Supreme Lord.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Lin'an Prefecture to build the Nine Palaces altar and its enclosures east of the capital, with rites modeled on the worship of the Supreme Lord.

sentences.zh: 其太一宮，初議者請即行宮之北隅建祠，後命禮官考典故，擇地建宮。

translations.literal: As for the Taiyi Palace, those who first deliberated requested that a shrine be built immediately at the north corner of the traveling palace; later the emperor ordered ritual officials to examine historical precedents and select a site to build the palace.
translations.idiomatic: Concerning the Great Unity Palace, early proposals called for erecting a shrine at the north corner of the traveling palace; the court later ordered ritual officials to consult historical precedents and choose a proper site for the palace.

sentences.zh: 十八年，宮成，禦書其榜。

translations.literal: In year 18, the palace was completed, and the emperor personally inscribed its plaque.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year, the palace was completed, and the emperor inscribed its name plaque in his own hand.

sentences.zh: 十太一位於殿上，南面，西上。

translations.literal: The ten Taiyi seats are on the hall platform, facing south, west elevated.
translations.idiomatic: The ten Great Unity seats were arranged on the hall platform, facing south with the west side elevated.

sentences.zh: 從祀，東廡九十有八，西廡九十有七，皆北上。

translations.literal: Accompanying sacrifices: the eastern wing has ninety-eight, the western wing ninety-seven; all north elevated.
translations.idiomatic: For accompanying sacrifices, the eastern wing held ninety-eight seats and the western wing ninety-seven; all were arranged with the north side elevated.

sentences.zh: 孝宗受禪，又建本命殿，名曰崇禧。

translations.literal: When Emperor Xiaozong received the abdication, he also built a natal-year hall, named Chongxi.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xiaozong ascended the throne, he also built a natal-year hall named Chongxi, "Reverent Blessings."

sentences.zh: 光宗又遷介福殿像於挾室，而名新殿曰崇福。

translations.literal: Emperor Guangzong also moved the image from Jiefu Hall to a side chamber, and named the new hall Chongfu.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Guangzong later moved the image from the Hall of Intermediate Blessings to a side chamber and named the new hall Chongfu, "Reverent Fortune."

sentences.zh: 高禖。

translations.literal: Gao Mei.
translations.idiomatic: The High Matchmaker.

sentences.zh: 初，仁宗未有嗣，景祐四年二月，以殿中侍御史張奎言，詔有司詳定。

translations.literal: Initially, Emperor Renzong had no heir. In the second month of Jingyou year 4, at the memorial of Supervising Censor-in-Attendance Zhang Kui, an edict ordered the relevant offices to examine and determine the rite in detail.
translations.idiomatic: At first Emperor Renzong had no heir. In the second month of the fourth year of Jingyou, responding to a memorial from Supervising Censor Zhang Kui, the emperor ordered the appropriate offices to examine the matter in detail.

sentences.zh: 禮官以為：「《月令》雖可據，然《周官》闕其文，《漢志》郊祀不及禖祠，獨《枚皋傳》言'皇子禖祝'而已。

translations.literal: The ritual officials considered: "Though the Monthly Ordinances may be relied upon, the Rites of Zhou lacks the relevant text; the Han Treatise on Sacrifices does not include matchmaker worship in suburban sacrifice; only the Biography of Mei Gao says 'princely child, matchmaker prayer' — and that is all.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual officials held: "Although the Monthly Ordinances may be cited, the Rites of Zhou omits the relevant passage; the Han Treatise on Suburban Sacrifice does not mention matchmaker worship; only the biography of Mei Gao records the phrase 'princely child, matchmaker prayer' — and nothing more.

sentences.zh: 後漢至江左概見其事，而儀典委曲，不可周知。

translations.literal: From Later Han through the Jiang-zuo period one can generally find references to the practice, but the rites and rules in their full detail cannot be fully known.
translations.idiomatic: From Later Han through the Jiang-zuo era one finds scattered references to the practice, but the full ritual details cannot be comprehensively recovered.

sentences.zh: 惟高齊禖祀最顯，妃嬪參享，黷而不蠲，恐不足為後世法。

translations.literal: Only the Northern Qi matchmaker sacrifice is most prominent; consorts participated in the offering — excessive and impure — and probably cannot serve as a model for later ages.
translations.idiomatic: Only the Northern Qi matchmaker rite is well documented, but with consorts joining in the offering — an impure excess that can scarcely serve as a model for later ages.

sentences.zh: 唐明皇因舊《月令》，特存其事。

translations.literal: Emperor Ming of Tang, following the old Monthly Ordinances, specially preserved the practice.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xuanzong of Tang, following the old Monthly Ordinances, specially preserved the rite.

sentences.zh: 開元定禮，已復不著。

translations.literal: When the Kaiyuan Ritual Code was compiled, it was already omitted again.
translations.idiomatic: By the time the Kaiyuan Ritual Code was codified, the rite had already dropped out once more.

sentences.zh: 朝廷必欲行之，當築壇于南郊，春分之日以祀青帝，本《詩》'克禋以祓'之義也。

translations.literal: If the court must implement it, an altar should be built at the southern suburbs; on the day of the spring equinox the Green Lord should be worshiped — in accord with the meaning of the Book of Songs phrase 'perform the pure offering to perform the lustration.'
translations.idiomatic: If the court insists on restoring the rite, an altar should be erected in the southern suburbs and the Green Lord worshiped on the spring equinox — in the spirit of the Odes' injunction to 'perform the pure offering for lustration.'

sentences.zh: 配以伏羲、帝嚳，伏羲本始，嚳著祥也。

translations.literal: Accompanied by Fuxi and Emperor Ku; Fuxi as origin, Ku as the one who manifested auspicious signs.
translations.idiomatic: Fuxi and Emperor Ku should serve as associates: Fuxi as the primal origin, Ku as the one through whom auspicious signs were manifest.

sentences.zh: 以禖從祀，報古為禖之先也。

translations.literal: The Matchmaker spirit as accompanying sacrifice, to repay the ancient ancestor of matchmaker worship.
translations.idiomatic: The Matchmaker spirit should accompany the sacrifice, returning thanks to the ancient progenitor of matchmaker worship.

sentences.zh: 以石為主，牲用太牢，樂以升歌，儀視先蠶，有司攝事，祝版所載，具言天子求嗣之意。

translations.literal: A stone serves as the spirit tablet; victims use the great offering; music uses ascending song; the rite follows that of the Silkworm Ancestress; officials perform the rite by proxy; the prayer tablet should fully state the Son of Heaven's wish for an heir.
translations.idiomatic: A stone tablet should serve as the spirit focus; a great offering of ox, sheep, and pig should be used; ascending hymn should be sung; the ceremony should follow the Silkworm Ancestress precedent; officials should perform the rite by proxy; and the prayer tablet should fully express the Son of Heaven's desire for an heir.

sentences.zh: 乃以弓矢、弓韣致神前，祀已，與胙酒進內，以禮所禦，使齋戒受之。

translations.literal: Then bows, arrows, and bow cases are presented before the spirit; after the sacrifice, sacrificial meat and wine are presented within the palace; the one whom the rite specially designates should observe abstinence and receive them.
translations.idiomatic: Bows, arrows, and bow cases should be presented before the spirit; after the sacrifice, sacrificial meat and wine should be brought into the palace for the woman designated by the rite to receive in a state of ritual abstinence.

sentences.zh: 仍歲令有司申請俟旨，命曰特祀。」

translations.literal: Each year officials should petition and await the imperial command; the rite should be termed a special sacrifice."
translations.idiomatic: Each year the relevant offices should petition and await the imperial order; the rite was to be designated a special sacrifice."

sentences.zh: 即用其年春分，遣官致祭。

translations.literal: Immediately in that year's spring equinox, officials were dispatched to perform the sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: The court promptly dispatched officials to perform the sacrifice at the spring equinox of that year.

sentences.zh: 為圜壇高九尺，廣二丈六尺，四陛，三壝，陛廣五尺，壝各二十五步。

translations.literal: A round altar was made nine chi high, two zhang six chi wide, with four stepped ramps, three enclosures; ramps five chi wide, each enclosure twenty-five bu.
translations.idiomatic: A round altar was constructed nine chi high and two zhang six chi wide, with four stepped ramps and triple enclosures; the ramps were five chi wide and each enclosure measured twenty-five bu.

sentences.zh: 主用青石，長三尺八寸，用木生成之數，形准廟社主，植壇上稍北，露其首三寸。

translations.literal: The spirit tablet used green stone, three chi eight cun long — using the number of wood's generative phase; shaped like the ancestral temple and soil-altar tablets; planted on the altar slightly to the north, exposing its top three cun.
translations.idiomatic: The spirit tablet was of green stone, three chi eight cun long — the measurement corresponding to the generative number of wood — shaped like the ancestral temple and altar-of-the-soil tablets; it was set on the altar slightly north of center, with three cun of its top exposed.

sentences.zh: 青玉、青幣，牲用牛一、羊一、豕一，如盧植之說。

translations.literal: Green jade and green silks; victims one ox, one sheep, one pig, as in Lu Zhi's account.
translations.idiomatic: Green jade and green silks were offered; the victims were one ox, one sheep, and one pig, following Lu Zhi's exposition.

sentences.zh: 樂章、祀儀並准青帝，尊器、神坐如勾芒，唯受福不飲，回授中人為異。

translations.literal: Hymns and sacrificial rites all followed the Green Lord; vessels and spirit seats like Goumang; the only difference was that in receiving blessings one did not drink, but returned them to the palace attendants.
translations.idiomatic: Hymns and ceremonial procedure all followed the Green Lord precedent; vessels and spirit seats were arranged as for Goumang; the only variation was that the recipient of blessings did not drink the wine but passed it back to the palace attendants.

sentences.zh: 祀前一日，內侍請皇后宿齋于別寢，內臣引近侍宮嬪從。

translations.literal: On the day before the sacrifice, palace attendants requested the empress to observe abstinence in a separate chamber; inner officials led attendant palace ladies to follow.
translations.idiomatic: On the eve of the sacrifice, palace attendants asked the empress to observe ritual abstinence in a separate chamber, and inner officials escorted attendant palace ladies to join her.

sentences.zh: 是日，量地設香案、褥位各二，重行，南向，於所齋之庭以望禖壇。

translations.literal: That day, ground was measured and incense tables and cushioned seats were set up, two each in double rows, facing south, in the abstinence courtyard facing the matchmaker altar.
translations.idiomatic: That day, in the abstinence courtyard facing the matchmaker altar, ground was measured and two incense tables and two rows of cushioned seats were arranged, all facing south.

sentences.zh: 又設褥位於香案北，重行。

translations.literal: Cushioned seats were also set north of the incense tables, in double rows.
translations.idiomatic: Additional rows of cushioned seats were placed north of the incense tables.

sentences.zh: 皇后服禕衣，褥位以緋。

translations.literal: The empress wore ceremonial robes; cushioned seats in crimson.
translations.idiomatic: The empress wore her ceremonial robes; her cushioned seat was crimson.

sentences.zh: 宮嬪服朝賀衣服，褥位以紫。

translations.literal: Palace ladies wore court congratulatory dress; cushioned seats in purple.
translations.idiomatic: Palace ladies wore their court congratulatory attire; their cushioned seats were purple.

sentences.zh: 祀日，有司行禮，以福酒、胙肉、弓矢、弓韣授內臣，奉至齋所，置弓矢等於箱，在香案東；

translations.literal: On the day of sacrifice, officials performed the rite and entrusted sacrificial wine, sacrificial meat, bows, arrows, and bow cases to inner officials, who brought them to the abstinence chamber; bows and arrows were placed in a chest east of the incense table;
translations.idiomatic: On the day of sacrifice, after officials completed the rite, they entrusted the sacrificial wine, meat, bows, arrows, and bow cases to inner officials, who conveyed them to the abstinence chamber; the bows and arrows were placed in a chest east of the incense table;

sentences.zh: 福酒於坫，胙肉於俎，在香案西。

translations.literal: sacrificial wine on the stand, sacrificial meat on the tray, west of the incense table.
translations.idiomatic: the sacrificial wine on a stand and the sacrificial meat on a tray, west of the incense table.

sentences.zh: 內臣引宮嬪詣褥位，東上南向。

translations.literal: Inner officials led palace ladies to the cushioned seats, east elevated, facing south.
translations.idiomatic: Inner officials led the palace ladies to their cushioned seats, arranged with the east side elevated and facing south.

sentences.zh: 乃請皇后行禮，導至褥位，皆再拜。

translations.literal: Then the empress was invited to perform the rite; she was led to the cushioned seat and all bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: The empress was then invited to perform the rite; she was conducted to her cushioned seat, and all bowed twice.

sentences.zh: 導皇后詣香案位，上香三，請帶弓韣，受弓矢，轉授內臣置於箱，又再拜。

translations.literal: The empress was led to the incense table; she offered incense three times, was asked to wear the bow case, received bows and arrows, and transferred them to inner officials to place in the chest; she bowed twice again.
translations.idiomatic: The empress was conducted to the incense table, where she offered incense three times, was asked to take up the bow case, received the bows and arrows, and passed them to inner officials to place in the chest; she then bowed twice again.

sentences.zh: 內臣進胙，皇后受訖，轉授內臣。

translations.literal: Inner officials presented sacrificial meat; the empress received it and transferred it to inner officials.
translations.idiomatic: Inner officials presented the sacrificial meat; the empress received it and passed it back to them.

sentences.zh: 次進福酒，內臣曰：「請飲福。」

translations.literal: Next sacrificial wine was presented; inner officials said: "Please drink the blessing wine."
translations.idiomatic: Sacrificial wine was then presented, and an inner official announced: "Please drink the blessing wine."

sentences.zh: 飲訖，請再拜。

translations.literal: After drinking, she was asked to bow twice.
translations.idiomatic: When she had finished drinking, she was asked to bow twice.

sentences.zh: 乃解弓韣，內臣跪受，置於箱。

translations.literal: Then she removed the bow case; inner officials kneeled to receive it and placed it in the chest.
translations.idiomatic: She then removed the bow case; inner officials knelt to receive it and returned it to the chest.

sentences.zh: 導皇后歸東向褥位。

translations.literal: The empress was led back to the east-facing cushioned seat.
translations.idiomatic: The empress was conducted back to her east-facing cushioned seat.

sentences.zh: 又引宮嬪最高一人詣香案，上香二，帶弓韣，受弓矢，轉授左右，及飲福，解弓韣，如皇后儀，唯不進胙。

translations.literal: The highest-ranking palace lady was also led to the incense table; she offered incense twice, wore the bow case, received bows and arrows, transferred them to attendants, drank the blessing wine, removed the bow case — following the empress's procedure, except she did not receive sacrificial meat.
translations.idiomatic: The highest-ranking palace lady was likewise conducted to the incense table, where she offered incense twice, took up the bow case, received the bows and arrows, passed them to attendants, drank the blessing wine, and removed the bow case — following the empress's procedure except that no sacrificial meat was presented to her.

sentences.zh: 又引以次宮嬪行禮，亦然。

translations.literal: Lower-ranking palace ladies were also led in turn to perform the rite, likewise.
translations.idiomatic: The remaining palace ladies were led forward in rank order to perform the same rite.

sentences.zh: 俟俱復位，內侍請皇后詣南向褥位，皆再拜退。

translations.literal: When all had returned to their seats, palace attendants invited the empress to the south-facing cushioned seat; all bowed twice and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: When all had returned to their places, palace attendants invited the empress to her south-facing cushioned seat; all bowed twice and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 是歲，宮中又置赤帝像以祈皇嗣。

translations.literal: That year, the palace also set up an image of the Red Lord to pray for an imperial heir.
translations.idiomatic: That same year, the palace also installed an image of the Red Lord to pray for an imperial heir.

sentences.zh: 寶元二年，皇子生，遣參知政事王鬷乙太牢報祠，准春分儀，惟不設弓矢、弓韣，著為常祀，遣兩制官攝事。

translations.literal: In Baoyuan year 2, when a prince was born, Vice Grand Councillor Wang Yan was dispatched with a great offering to report the event; following the spring equinox rite except without bow and arrow or bow case; established as a regular sacrifice, with academicians performing by proxy.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Baoyuan, when a prince was born, Vice Grand Councillor Wang Yan was dispatched to offer a great sacrifice in thanksgiving, following the spring equinox ceremony except without bows, arrows, or bow cases; this was established as a regular sacrifice, performed by proxy by Hanlin academicians.

sentences.zh: 慶曆三年，太常博士余靖言：「皇帝嗣續未廣，不設弓矢、弓韣，非是。」

translations.literal: In Qingli year 3, Doctor of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Yu Jing said: "The emperor's succession is not yet broad; not providing bows, arrows, and bow cases is wrong."
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Qingli, Doctor of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Yu Jing submitted a memorial: "The imperial succession is not yet secure; omitting the bows, arrows, and bow cases is mistaken."

sentences.zh: 詔仍如景祐之制。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that the Jingyou institution be followed.
translations.idiomatic: An edict restored the institution of the Jingyou era.

sentences.zh: 熙甯二年，皇子生，乙太牢報祀高禖，惟不設弓矢，弓韣。

translations.literal: In Xining year 2, when a prince was born, a great offering was dispatched to report the sacrifice to Gao Mei, except without bows, arrows, or bow cases.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Xining, when a prince was born, a great offering was dispatched in thanksgiving at the High Matchmaker altar — but again without bows, arrows, or bow cases.

sentences.zh: 既又從禮官言：「按祀儀，青帝壇廣四丈，高八尺。

translations.literal: Subsequently, following the ritual officials' memorial: "According to the sacrificial rites, the Green Lord altar is four zhang wide and eight chi high.
translations.idiomatic: The court then adopted a proposal from the ritual officials: "According to the sacrificial regulations, the Green Lord altar is four zhang wide and eight chi high.

sentences.zh: 今祠高禖既以青帝為主，其壇高廣，請如青帝之制。

translations.literal: Now that Gao Mei worship takes the Green Lord as chief spirit, the altar's height and width should follow the Green Lord institution, it was requested.
translations.idiomatic: Since the High Matchmaker rite now takes the Green Lord as its chief spirit, the altar's dimensions should follow the Green Lord standard.

sentences.zh: 又祀天以高禖配，今郊禖壇祀青帝於南郊，以伏羲、高辛配，復于壇下設高禖位，殊為爽誤。

translations.literal: Also, in worshiping Heaven Gao Mei serves as associate; now at the suburban matchmaker altar the Green Lord is worshiped at the southern suburbs with Fuxi and Gaoxin as associates, yet a Gao Mei seat is also set below the altar — a serious inconsistency.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, in ancient suburban matchmaker worship, the Matchmaker spirit served as associate to Heaven; yet the present altar worships the Green Lord at the southern suburbs with Fuxi and Gaoxin as associates while also placing a separate Matchmaker seat below the altar — a grave inconsistency.

sentences.zh: 請准古郊禖，改祀上帝，以高禖配，改伏羲、高辛位為高禖，而徹壇下位。」

translations.literal: It was requested to follow the ancient suburban matchmaker rite: worship the Supreme Lord instead, with Gao Mei as associate; change the Fuxi and Gaoxin seats to Gao Mei, and remove the lower altar seat."
translations.idiomatic: I request that the ancient suburban matchmaker model be followed: worship the Supreme Lord with the Matchmaker as associate, convert the Fuxi and Gaoxin seats into Matchmaker seats, and remove the lower altar placement."

sentences.zh: 詔：「高禖典禮仍舊，壇制如所議，改犢為角握牛，高禖祝版與配位並進書焉。」

translations.literal: Edict: "The Gao Mei canon remains as before; the altar dimensions as proposed; change the calf victim to a horn-gripped ox; the Gao Mei prayer tablet and associate seats shall all be inscribed in writing."
translations.idiomatic: The edict replied: "The High Matchmaker ceremonial canon remains unchanged; adopt the proposed altar dimensions; substitute a horn-gripped ox for the calf victim; and inscribe both the Matchmaker prayer tablet and the associate seats in full."

sentences.zh: 又言：「伏羲、高辛配，祝文並雲'作主配神'。

translations.literal: Also stated: "For Fuxi and Gaoxin as associates, the prayer texts both say 'serving as chief associate spirit.'
translations.idiomatic: A further proposal noted: "For Fuxi and Gaoxin as associates, the prayer texts both read 'serving as chief associate spirit.'

sentences.zh: 神無二主，伏羲既為主，其高辛祝文，請改雲'配食於神'。」

translations.literal: A spirit has no two chiefs; since Fuxi is already chief, Gaoxin's prayer text should be changed to say 'serving as associate at the feast of the spirit.'"
translations.idiomatic: A spirit cannot have two chiefs; since Fuxi already serves as chief associate, Gaoxin's prayer text should be revised to read 'partaking as associate at the spirit's feast.'"

sentences.zh: 元祐三年，太常寺言：「祀儀，高禖壇上正位設青帝席，配位設伏羲、高辛氏席，壇下東南設高禖，從祀席正配位各六俎，實以羊、豕腥熟，高禖位四俎，實以牛腥熟。

translations.literal: In Yuanyou year 3, the Court of Imperial Sacrifices stated: "According to the sacrificial rites, on the Gao Mei altar the main seat has a Green Lord mat; associate seats have Fuxi and Gaoxin mats; southeast below the altar Gao Mei is set; accompanying sacrifice mats — main and associate each six trays, filled with raw and cooked sheep and pig; Gao Mei seat four trays, filled with raw and cooked ox.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Yuanyou, the Court of Imperial Sacrifices reported: "According to the sacrificial regulations, the Green Lord mat occupies the chief seat on the High Matchmaker altar, with mats for Fuxi and Gaoxin at the associate seats; the Matchmaker spirit is placed southeast below the altar. Main and associate seats each receive six offering trays of raw and cooked mutton and pork; the Matchmaker seat receives four trays of raw and cooked beef.

sentences.zh: 祀日，兵部、工部郎中奉羊、豕俎升壇，詣正配位。

translations.literal: On the day of sacrifice, directors of the Ministries of War and Works bore sheep and pig trays up the altar to the main and associate seats.
translations.idiomatic: On the day of sacrifice, directors from the Ministries of War and Works carried the mutton and pork trays up the altar to the chief and associate seats.

sentences.zh: 高禖位俎，則執事人奉焉。

translations.literal: The Gao Mei seat trays were borne by attendants.
translations.idiomatic: The Matchmaker offering trays were carried by attendants.

sentences.zh: 竊以青帝為所祀之主，而牲用羊豕；

translations.literal: Privately considered: the Green Lord is the chief spirit worshiped, yet the victims are sheep and pig;
translations.idiomatic: It seems to us that although the Green Lord is the chief spirit worshiped, the victims offered are mutton and pork;

sentences.zh: 禖神因其嘉祥從祀，而牲反用牛，又牛俎執事者陳之，而羊、豕俎皆奉以郎官，輕重失當。

translations.literal: the Matchmaker spirit accompanies as an auspicious associate, yet the victim is ox; moreover ox trays are presented by attendants while sheep and pig trays are borne by directors — the weight accorded is inappropriate.
translations.idiomatic: yet the Matchmaker, though merely an auspicious accompanying spirit, receives beef; moreover, attendants present the beef trays while directors carry the mutton and pork — a misalignment of ritual precedence.

sentences.zh: 請以三牲通行解割，正、配、眾祀位並用，皆以六曹郎官奉俎。

translations.literal: Request that the three victims be used uniformly for dismemberment; main, associate, and all sacrifice seats alike; all trays borne by directors of the Six Ministries.
translations.idiomatic: I request that the three victims be uniformly dismembered and offered at the chief, associate, and all accompanying seats alike, with directors from all Six Ministries bearing the trays.

sentences.zh: 今羊俎以兵部，豕俎以工部，牛俎請以戶部郎官。」

translations.literal: Now sheep trays by the Ministry of War, pig trays by the Ministry of Works; ox trays request the director of the Ministry of Revenue."
translations.idiomatic: Let the Ministry of War bear the mutton trays, the Ministry of Works the pork trays, and the Ministry of Revenue the beef trays."

sentences.zh: 《政和新儀》：春分祀高禖，以簡狄、薑嫄從祀，皇帝親祠，並如祈穀祀上帝儀。

translations.literal: The New Rites of Zhenghe: at spring equinox Gao Mei is worshiped, with Jiandi and Jiang Yuan as accompanying sacrifices; the emperor worships in person, all following the rite of praying for grain and worshiping the Supreme Lord.
translations.idiomatic: New Rites of the Zhenghe Era: At the spring equinox the High Matchmaker is worshiped, with Jiandi and Jiang Yuan as accompanying spirits; the emperor performs the rite in person, following the ceremony for praying for grain and worshiping the Supreme Lord.

sentences.zh: 惟配位作《承安》之樂，而增簡狄、姜嫄位牛、羊、豕各一。

translations.literal: Only at the associate seats is the Chengan hymn performed; and for Jiandi and Jiang Yuan seats one each of ox, sheep, and pig is added.
translations.idiomatic: At the associate seats alone the hymn Chengan was performed; offerings of one ox, one sheep, and one pig were added at the seats of Jiandi and Jiang Yuan.

sentences.zh: 紹興元年，太常少卿趙子畫言：「自車駕南巡，雖多故之余，禮文難備，至於祓無子，祝多男，所以系萬方之心，蓋不可闕。

translations.literal: In Shaoxing year 1, Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Zhao Zihua said: "Since the imperial carriage moved south, though in troubled times and ritual texts hard to complete, as for lustration for the childless and prayer for many sons — by which the hearts of all regions are bound — this surely cannot be omitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Shaoxing, Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Zhao Zihua submitted a memorial: "Since the court moved south, ritual texts have been difficult to maintain amid pressing affairs; yet the lustration for the childless and prayer for many sons — by which the hearts of the realm are bound — surely cannot be abandoned.

sentences.zh: 乞自來歲之春，復行高禖之祀。」

translations.literal: Request that from next spring the Gao Mei sacrifice be restored."
translations.idiomatic: I ask that the High Matchmaker sacrifice be restored beginning next spring."

sentences.zh: 十七年，車駕親祀高禖，如政和之儀。

translations.literal: In year 17, the imperial carriage worshiped Gao Mei in person, following the Zhenghe rite.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year, the emperor worshiped the High Matchmaker in person, following the Zhenghe ceremony.

sentences.zh: 大火之祀。

translations.literal: Worship of the Great Fire.
translations.idiomatic: Worship of the Great Fire Star.

sentences.zh: 康定初，南京鴻慶宮災，集賢校理胡宿請修其祀，而以閼伯配焉。

translations.literal: Early in Kangding, the Hongqing Palace at Nanjing burned; Academician Editor Hu Su requested restoration of its worship, with Yanbo as associate.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Kangding era, Hongqing Palace at Nanjing was destroyed by fire; Academician Editor Hu Su petitioned for restoration of the Great Fire worship, with Yanbo as associate spirit.

sentences.zh: 禮官議：「閼伯為高辛火正，實居商丘，主祀大火。

translations.literal: Ritual officials deliberated: "Yanbo was Gaoxin's Director of Fire, dwelling at Shangqiu, chiefly worshiping the Great Fire.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual officials argued: "Yanbo served as Director of Fire under Emperor Ku and dwelt at Shangqiu, where he chiefly maintained worship of the Great Fire Star.

sentences.zh: 後世因之，祀為貴神，配火侑食，如周棄配稷、後士配社之比，下曆千載，遂為重祀。

translations.literal: Later ages followed this, worshiping him as an honored spirit, accompanying the Fire as offering food — like how Hou Ji accompanied the Grain and Hou Tu accompanied the Soil — spanning a thousand years, thus becoming a major sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: Later ages followed this precedent, enshrining him as an honored spirit who accompanies the Fire Star at the feast — as Hou Ji accompanies the Grain Spirit and Hou Tu the Soil Spirit — and over a millennium this became a ceremony of the first rank.

sentences.zh: 祖宗以來，郊祀上帝，而大辰已在從祀，閼伯之廟，每因赦文及春秋，委京司長吏致奠，鹹秩之典，未始雲闕。

translations.literal: Since the founding ancestors, in suburban worship of the Supreme Lord the Great Chen is already among accompanying sacrifices; Yanbo's temple, whenever amnesty proclamations and spring and autumn observances occur, is entrusted to the capital's chief officials for offerings — the full canon of sacrificial rank has never been neglected.
translations.idiomatic: Since the founding of the dynasty, the Great Fire Star has been included among the accompanying spirits at suburban worship of the Supreme Lord; Yanbo's temple receives offerings from the capital's chief officials at each amnesty and at spring and autumn — the full ceremonial canon has never truly lapsed.

sentences.zh: 然國家有天下之號實本于宋，五運之次，又感火德，宜因興王之地，商丘之舊，為壇兆祀大火，以閼伯配。

translations.literal: Yet the state title by which the empire holds all under Heaven originally derives from Song; among the Five Phases the dynasty corresponds to the Fire Virtue — it is fitting to follow the place where the dynasty rose, the old site of Shangqiu, to establish an altar precinct worshiping the Great Fire, with Yanbo as associate.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the dynastic name by which the empire holds sway originally derives from Song; the dynasty moreover belongs to the phase of Fire — it is fitting to establish an altar at Shangqiu, the ancient seat where the dynasty rose, to worship the Great Fire Star with Yanbo as associate.

sentences.zh: 建辰、建戌出內之月，內降祝版，留司長吏奉祭行事。」

translations.literal: In the months of jian-chen and jian-xu when the court leaves the capital, prayer tablets are issued from within; resident chief officials perform the sacrifices."
translations.idiomatic: In the jian-chen and jian-xu months when the court is absent from the capital, prayer tablets should be issued from the palace and the resident chief officials should perform the sacrifices."

sentences.zh: 乃上壇制：高五尺，廣二丈，四陛，陛廣五尺，一壝，四面距壇各二十五步。

translations.literal: Thereupon the altar dimensions were submitted: five chi high, two zhang wide, four stepped ramps, ramps five chi wide, one enclosure, on all four sides twenty-five bu from the altar.
translations.idiomatic: The proposed altar specifications followed: five chi high and two zhang wide, with four stepped ramps five chi wide, a single enclosure, and twenty-five bu on every side from the altar platform.

sentences.zh: 位牌以黑漆朱書曰大火位，配位曰閼伯位。

translations.literal: Spirit tablets in black lacquer with vermilion writing: "Great Fire Seat," associate seat "Yanbo Seat."
translations.idiomatic: Spirit tablets of black lacquer inscribed in vermilion read "Seat of the Great Fire" and "Seat of Yanbo" for the associate placement.

sentences.zh: 牲用羊、豕一，器准中祠。

translations.literal: Victims one sheep and one pig; vessels following medium sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: The victims were one sheep and one pig; vessels followed the medium-sacrifice standard.

sentences.zh: 歲以三月、九月擇日，令南京長吏以下分三獻，州、縣官攝太祝、奉禮。

translations.literal: Each year on chosen days in the third and ninth months, Nanjing chief officials and below perform the threefold presentation; prefectural and county officials serve as proxy Grand Invocators and Ritual Attendants.
translations.idiomatic: On chosen days in the third and ninth months each year, Nanjing's chief officials and their subordinates were to perform the threefold presentation, with prefectural and county officials serving as proxy Grand Invocators and Ritual Attendants.

sentences.zh: 慶曆，獻官有祭服。

translations.literal: In Qingli, presenting officials had sacrificial robes.
translations.idiomatic: During the Qingli era, presenting officials were provided with sacrificial robes.

sentences.zh: 建中靖國元年又建陽德觀以祀熒惑。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jianzhong Jingguo, Yangde Abbey was also built to worship the Sparkling Deluder.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Jianzhong Jingguo, Yangde Abbey was built to worship the Sparkling Deluder.

sentences.zh: 因翰林學士張康國言，天下崇寧觀並建火德真君殿，仍詔正殿以離明為名。

translations.literal: Following Academician Zhang Kangguo's memorial, Chongning Abbeys throughout the empire all built Halls of the True Lord of Fire Virtue; an edict also named the main hall Liming.
translations.idiomatic: Following a memorial from Hanlin Academician Zhang Kangguo, every Chongning Abbey in the empire was ordered to build a Hall of the True Lord of Fire Virtue, and the main hall was named Luminous Li.

sentences.zh: 太常博士羅畸請宜仿太一宮，遣官薦獻，或立壇於南郊，如祀靈星、壽星之儀。

translations.literal: Doctor of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Luo Qi requested that it should follow the Taiyi Palace model, dispatching officials for offering presentation, or establish an altar at the southern suburbs like the rites for Spirit Star and Longevity Star.
translations.idiomatic: Doctor of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Luo Qi proposed that worship follow the Great Unity Palace model, with officials dispatched to present offerings, or that an altar be erected in the southern suburbs following the ceremonies for the Spirit Star and Longevity Star.

sentences.zh: 有司請以閼伯從祀離明殿，又請增閼伯位。

translations.literal: The relevant offices requested that Yanbo accompany worship at the Liming Hall, and also requested adding a Yanbo seat.
translations.idiomatic: The relevant offices proposed that Yanbo accompany worship at the Luminous Li Hall and also requested an additional seat for Yanbo.

sentences.zh: 按《春秋傳》曰：五行之官封為上公，祀為貴神。

translations.literal: According to the Spring and Autumn Annals commentary: "Officials of the Five Phases were enfeoffed as highest lords and worshiped as honored spirits."
translations.idiomatic: According to the Commentary on the Spring and Autumn Annals: "The officials of the Five Phases were enfeoffed as highest lords and worshiped as honored spirits."

sentences.zh: 祝融，高辛氏之火正也；

translations.literal: Zhurong was Gaoxin's Director of Fire;
translations.idiomatic: Zhurong served as Director of Fire under Emperor Ku;

sentences.zh: 閼伯，陶唐氏之火正也。

translations.literal: Yanbo was Taotang's Director of Fire.
translations.idiomatic: Yanbo served as Director of Fire under the House of Taotang.

sentences.zh: 祝融既為上公，則閼伯亦當服上公袞冕九章之服。

translations.literal: Since Zhurong had already been made an upper duke, Yanbo too ought to wear the upper duke's ceremonial robes and nine-pattern regalia.
translations.idiomatic: If Zhurong had been ennobled as an upper duke, then Yanbo too ought to wear the upper duke's full ceremonial dress with its nine emblems.

sentences.zh: 既又建熒惑壇於南郊赤帝壇壝外，令有司以時致祭，增用圭璧，火德、熒惑以閼伯配，俱南向。

translations.literal: They further built a Mars altar outside the enclosure of the Red Emperor's altar at the southern suburb, ordered the officials to make offerings at the proper seasons, added the use of gui and bi jades, paired Yanbo with the Fire Virtue and Mars, both facing south.
translations.idiomatic: They also built an altar to Mars outside the Red Emperor's enclosure at the southern suburb, ordered the proper officials to sacrifice at the appointed seasons, added gui and bi jades to the rite, and paired Yanbo with both the Fire Virtue and Mars, all facing south.

sentences.zh: 五方火精、神等為從祀。

translations.literal: The fire essences and spirits of the five directions served as associated sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: The fire essences and spirits of the five directions were included as attendant sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 壇廣四丈，高七尺，四陛，兩壝，壝二十五步，從《新儀》所定。

translations.literal: The altar was four zhang across and seven chi high, with four stairways, two enclosures, each enclosure twenty-five paces — all as fixed in the New Ritual Manual.
translations.idiomatic: The altar measured four zhang across and seven chi high, with four stairways and two enclosures of twenty-five paces each, all as prescribed in the New Ritual Manual.

sentences.zh: 紹興三年，詔祀大火。
