translations.literal: In the third year of Shaoxing, an edict ordered sacrifice to the Great Fire.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Shaoxing, an imperial edict ordered sacrifice to the Great Fire star.

sentences.zh: 太常寺言：「應天府祀大火，今道路未通，宜於行在春秋設位。」

translations.literal: The Court of Imperial Sacrifices submitted: "Yingtian Prefecture sacrifices to the Great Fire; as the roads are not yet open, altars should be set up at the southern capital in spring and autumn."
translations.idiomatic: The Court of Imperial Sacrifices reported: "Yingtian Prefecture performs sacrifice to the Great Fire, but the roads are not yet passable; altars should therefore be set up at the southern capital in spring and autumn."

sentences.zh: 乾道五年，太常少卿林栗等言：「本寺已擇九月十四日，依旨設位，望祭應天府大火，以商丘宣明王配。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Qiandao, Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Lin Li and others submitted: "This court has chosen the fourteenth day of the ninth month to set up the altar as instructed, to perform a distancing sacrifice to the Great Fire of Yingtian Prefecture, with the Xuanming King of Shangqiu as the paired deity.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Qiandao, Vice Director Lin Li of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and others submitted: "This office has chosen the fourteenth day of the ninth month to set up the altar as ordered and perform a distancing sacrifice to the Great Fire of Yingtian Prefecture, with the Xuanming King of Shangqiu as the paired deity.

sentences.zh: 二十一日內火，祀大辰，以閼伯配。

translations.literal: On the twenty-first day, at the appearance of the inner fire, sacrifice was made to the Great Star, with Yanbo as the paired deity.
translations.idiomatic: On the twenty-first day, when the inner fire star appeared, sacrifice was offered to the Great Star, with Yanbo as the paired deity.

sentences.zh: 大辰即大火，閼伯即商丘宣明王也。

translations.literal: The Great Star is the Great Fire; Yanbo is the Xuanming King of Shangqiu.
translations.idiomatic: The Great Star is the Great Fire, and Yanbo is the Xuanming King of Shangqiu.

sentences.zh: 緣國朝以宋建號，以火紀德，推原發祥之所自，崇建商丘之祠，府曰應天，廟曰光德，加封王爵，錫諡宣明，所以追嚴者備矣。

translations.literal: Because our dynasty took Song as its dynastic name and counted its virtue as fire, tracing back to where its felicitous rise began, it exalted the shrine at Shangqiu — the prefecture was named Yingtian, the temple Guangde — granted a princely title and bestowed the posthumous epithet Xuanming; every measure of reverence had been provided.
translations.idiomatic: Since the dynasty had taken Song as its name and counted fire as its virtue, tracing its auspicious origins, it had exalted the shrine at Shangqiu — naming the prefecture Yingtian and the temple Guangde, granting a royal title and the posthumous epithet Xuanming — and had already done everything possible to honor it.

sentences.zh: 今有司旬日之間舉行二祭，一稱其號，一斥其名，義所未安。

translations.literal: Now the officials perform two sacrifices within a ten-day span, calling him by his title in one and by his personal name in the other — a discrepancy we find disquieting.
translations.idiomatic: Yet now the officials hold two sacrifices within a ten-day span, using his title in one and his personal name in the other — a practice we find troubling.

sentences.zh: 乞自今祀熒惑、大辰，其配位稱閼伯，祝文、位板並依應天府大火禮例，改稱宣明王，以稱國家崇奉火正之意。」

translations.literal: We request that henceforth, when sacrificing to Mars and the Great Star, the paired seat be called Yanbo, while the invocation text and name tablets follow the precedent of the Great Fire at Yingtian Prefecture and use the title Xuanming King, in keeping with the state's reverence for the Director of Fire."
translations.idiomatic: We ask that henceforth, when sacrificing to Mars and the Great Star, the paired seat be called Yanbo, while the invocation text and name tablets follow the Great Fire rite of Yingtian Prefecture and use the title Xuanming King, in accord with the state's reverence for the Director of Fire."

sentences.zh: 諸星祠，有壽星、周伯、靈星之祭。

translations.literal: Among the stellar shrines, there were sacrifices to the Star of Longevity, Zhoubo, and the Spirit Star.
translations.idiomatic: Among the stellar shrines were sacrifices to the Star of Longevity, the Zhoubo star, and the Spirit Star.

sentences.zh: 大中祥符二年，翰林天文邢中和言：「景德中，周伯星出亢宿下。

translations.literal: In the second year of Dazhong Xiangfu, the Hanlin astronomer Xing Zhonghe submitted: "During the Jingde era, the Zhoubo star appeared below the mansion Kang.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Dazhong Xiangfu, the Hanlin astronomer Xing Zhonghe reported: "During the Jingde era, the Zhoubo star appeared beneath the mansion Kang.

sentences.zh: 按《天文志》，角、亢為太山之根，果符上封之應。

translations.literal: According to the Astronomical Treatise, Jiao and Kang are the root of Mount Tai — truly matching the portent of the feng sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: According to the Astronomical Treatise, Jiao and Kang are the root of Mount Tai — a sign that truly matched the portent of the feng sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 望於親郊日特置周伯星位於亢、宿間。」

translations.literal: It was hoped that on the day of the personal suburban sacrifice a special position for the Zhoubo star would be set between the mansions Kang and Xiu."
translations.idiomatic: It was proposed that on the day of the emperor's personal suburban sacrifice a special seat for the Zhoubo star be set between the mansions Kang and Xiu."

sentences.zh: 詔禮官與司天監定議，且言：「周伯星出氐三度，然亢、氐相去不遠，並鄭分。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the ritual officials and the Directorate of Astronomy to fix the arrangement, stating: "The Zhoubo star appeared at three degrees of Di; yet Kang and Di are not far apart, both falling within the division of Zheng.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the ritual officials and the Directorate of Astronomy to decide the matter, stating: "The Zhoubo star appeared at three degrees of Di; yet Kang and Di are not far apart, both within the asterism of Zheng.

sentences.zh: 兗州，壽星之次，宜如中和奏，設位氐宿之間，以為永式。」

translations.literal: Yanzhou is the asterism of the Star of Longevity; the arrangement should follow Zhonghe's memorial, with the seat set between the mansion Di, to serve as a permanent precedent."
translations.idiomatic: Yanzhou is the seat of the Star of Longevity; the arrangement should follow Zhonghe's proposal, with the seat set between the mansion Di, to serve as a permanent precedent."

sentences.zh: 景德三年，詔定壽星之祀。

translations.literal: In the third year of Jingde, an edict fixed the sacrifice to the Star of Longevity.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Jingde, an edict established the sacrifice to the Star of Longevity.

sentences.zh: 太常禮院言：「按《月令》：'八月，命有司享壽星于南郊。

translations.literal: The Court of Imperial Sacrifices Ritual Office submitted: "According to the Monthly Ordinances: 'In the eighth month, order the officials to offer sacrifice to the Star of Longevity at the southern suburb.'
translations.idiomatic: The Ritual Office of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices reported: "According to the Monthly Ordinances: 'In the eighth month, order the officials to sacrifice to the Star of Longevity at the southern suburb.'

sentences.zh: '《注》云：'秋分日，祭壽星于南郊。

translations.literal: The commentary says: 'On the day of the autumn equinox, sacrifice to the Star of Longevity at the southern suburb.'
translations.idiomatic: The commentary says: 'On the autumn equinox, sacrifice to the Star of Longevity at the southern suburb.'

sentences.zh: 壽星，南極老人星也。

translations.literal: The Star of Longevity is the Old Man star at the South Pole.
translations.idiomatic: The Star of Longevity is the Old Man star at the South Pole.

sentences.zh: '《爾雅》云：'壽星，角、亢也。

translations.literal: The Erya says: 'The Star of Longevity is Jiao and Kang.'
translations.idiomatic: The Erya says: 'The Star of Longevity is Jiao and Kang.'

sentences.zh: '《注》云：'數起角、亢，列宿之長，故云壽星。

translations.literal: The commentary says: 'The count begins with Jiao and Kang, the chiefs among the lodges — hence they are called the Star of Longevity.'
translations.idiomatic: The commentary says: 'The count begins with Jiao and Kang, the chiefs among the lodges — hence they are called the Star of Longevity.'

sentences.zh: '唐開元中，特置壽星壇，常以千秋節日祭老人星及角、亢七宿。

translations.literal: In the Kaiyuan era of Tang, a special Star of Longevity altar was established, and on the Thousand Autumns Festival the Old Man star and the seven lodges from Jiao through Kang were regularly sacrificed to.
translations.idiomatic: In Tang's Kaiyuan era, a special Star of Longevity altar was established, and on the Thousand Autumns Festival the Old Man star and the seven lodges from Jiao through Kang were regularly sacrificed to.

sentences.zh: 請用祀靈星小祠禮，其壇亦如靈星壇制，築於南郊，以秋分日祭之。」

translations.literal: We request the use of the minor rite for sacrificing to the Spirit Star; the altar should likewise follow the Spirit Star altar design, built at the southern suburb and sacrificed to on the autumn equinox."
translations.idiomatic: We ask that the minor rite for the Spirit Star be used, with an altar built at the southern suburb on the Spirit Star model and sacrificed to on the autumn equinox."

sentences.zh: 元豐中，禮文所言：「時令秋分，享壽星于南郊。

translations.literal: During the Yuanfeng era, the Ritual Office submitted: "By seasonal ordinance, at the autumn equinox sacrifice to the Star of Longevity at the southern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: During the Yuanfeng era, the Ritual Office reported: "By seasonal ordinance, at the autumn equinox sacrifice to the Star of Longevity at the southern suburb.

sentences.zh: 熙寧祀儀：于壇上設壽星一位，南向。

translations.literal: The Xining sacrificial regulations: on the altar a single seat for the Star of Longevity was set, facing south.
translations.idiomatic: The Xining sacrificial regulations set a single seat for the Star of Longevity on the altar, facing south.

sentences.zh: 又於壇下卯陛之南設角、亢、氐、房、心、尾、箕七位，東向。

translations.literal: Below the altar, south of the mao stairway, seven seats were set for Jiao, Kang, Di, Fang, Xin, Wei, and Ji, all facing east.
translations.idiomatic: Below the altar, south of the mao stairway, seven seats were set for Jiao, Kang, Di, Fang, Xin, Wei, and Ji, all facing east.

sentences.zh: 按《爾雅》所謂'壽星角、亢'，非此所謂秋分所享壽星也。

translations.literal: According to the Erya's phrase 'the Star of Longevity is Jiao and Kang,' this is not the Star of Longevity sacrificed to at the autumn equinox.
translations.idiomatic: The Erya's phrase 'the Star of Longevity is Jiao and Kang' refers to something other than the Star of Longevity sacrificed to at the autumn equinox.

sentences.zh: 今於壇下設角、亢位，以氐、房、心、尾、箕同祀，尤為無名。

translations.literal: To set seats for Jiao and Kang below the altar and sacrifice to Di, Fang, Xin, Wei, and Ji together with them is especially without justification.
translations.idiomatic: Setting seats for Jiao and Kang below the altar and sacrificing to Di, Fang, Xin, Wei, and Ji together with them is especially without precedent.

sentences.zh: 又按晉《天文志》：'老人一星在弧南，一日南極，常以秋分之旦見於丙，春分之夕沒于丁，見則治平，主壽昌，常以秋分候之南郊。」

translations.literal: Further, according to the Jin Astronomical Treatise: 'The Old Man star is south of Hu — also called the South Pole — regularly appearing at dawn on the autumn equinox in the bing direction and setting at dusk on the spring equinox in the ding direction; when it appears, governance is peaceful and longevity flourishes; it is regularly observed at the southern suburb on the autumn equinox.'"
translations.idiomatic: Further, according to the Jin Astronomical Treatise: 'The Old Man star lies south of Hu — also called the South Pole — regularly appearing at dawn on the autumn equinox in the bing direction and setting at dusk on the spring equinox in the ding direction; when it appears, the realm is at peace and longevity flourishes; it is regularly observed at the southern suburb on the autumn equinox.'"

sentences.zh: 後漢于國都南郊立老人星廟，常以仲秋祀之，則壽星謂老人矣。

translations.literal: Later Han established a shrine to the Old Man star at the southern suburb of the capital and regularly sacrificed to it in mid-autumn — thus the Star of Longevity means the Old Man star.
translations.idiomatic: Later Han established a shrine to the Old Man star at the southern suburb of the capital and regularly sacrificed to it in mid-autumn — showing that the Star of Longevity means the Old Man star.

sentences.zh: 請依後漢，於壇上設壽星一位，南向，祀老人星。

translations.literal: We request that, following Later Han, a single seat for the Star of Longevity be set on the altar, facing south, to sacrifice to the Old Man star.
translations.idiomatic: We ask that, following Later Han, a single seat for the Star of Longevity be set on the altar, facing south, to sacrifice to the Old Man star.

sentences.zh: 其壇下七宿位不宜復設。」

translations.literal: The seven lodge seats below the altar should not be set up again.
translations.idiomatic: The seven lodge seats below the altar should not be restored.

sentences.zh: 慶曆以立秋後辰日祀靈星，其壇東西丈三尺，南北丈二尺，壽星壇方丈八尺。

translations.literal: In Qingli, the Spirit Star was sacrificed to on a chen day after the Start of Autumn; its altar was one zhang three chi east to west and one zhang two chi north to south; the Star of Longevity altar was one zhang eight chi square.
translations.idiomatic: Under Qingli, the Spirit Star was sacrificed to on a chen day after the Start of Autumn; its altar measured one zhang three chi east to west and one zhang two chi north to south, and the Star of Longevity altar one zhang eight chi square.

sentences.zh: 皇祐定如唐制，二壇皆周八步四尺。

translations.literal: In Huangyou both altars were fixed at eight paces four chi in circumference, following Tang practice.
translations.idiomatic: In Huangyou both altars were fixed at eight paces four chi in circumference, following Tang practice.

sentences.zh: 其享禮，籩八，豆八，在神位前左右，重三行。

translations.literal: For the offering rite, eight bian and eight dou were placed before and to the left and right of the spirit seat, in three rows.
translations.idiomatic: For the offering rite, eight bian and eight dou were placed before and to either side of the spirit seat, arranged in three rows.

sentences.zh: 俎二，在籩、豆外，簠、簋一，在二俎間。

translations.literal: Two zu stood outside the bian and dou; one fu and one gui were placed between the two zu.
translations.idiomatic: Two zu stood outside the bian and dou; one fu and one gui were placed between the two zu.

sentences.zh: 象尊二，在壇上東南隅，北向西上。

translations.literal: Two elephant goblets stood in the southeast corner of the altar, facing northwest and ascending from the north.
translations.idiomatic: Two elephant goblets stood in the southeast corner of the altar, facing northwest with the higher side to the north.

sentences.zh: 七宿位各設籩一，豆一，在神位前左右。

translations.literal: At each of the seven lodge seats one bian and one dou were set before and to the left and right of the spirit seat.
translations.idiomatic: At each of the seven lodge seats one bian and one dou were set before and to either side of the spirit seat.

sentences.zh: 俎一，在籩、豆外，中設簠一、簋一，在俎左右。

translations.literal: One zu stood outside the bian and dou; in the center one fu and one gui were set to the left and right of the zu.
translations.idiomatic: One zu stood outside the bian and dou; in the center one fu and one gui were set to either side of the zu.

sentences.zh: 爵一，在神位正前。

translations.literal: One jue stood directly before the spirit seat.
translations.idiomatic: One jue cup stood directly before the spirit seat.

sentences.zh: 壺尊二，在神位右。

translations.literal: Two hu goblets stood to the right of the spirit seat.
translations.idiomatic: Two hu goblets stood to the right of the spirit seat.

sentences.zh: 光祿實以法酒。

translations.literal: The Director of Imperial Entertainment filled them with ritual wine.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of Imperial Entertainment filled them with ritual wine.

sentences.zh: 《政和新儀》改定：壇高三尺，東西袤丈三尺，南北袤丈二尺，四出陛，一壝，二十五步。

translations.literal: The New Rituals of the Zhenghe Era revised the design: the altar was three chi high, one zhang three chi east to west and one zhang two chi north to south, with four outward stairways, one enclosure, and twenty-five paces.
translations.idiomatic: The New Rituals of the Zhenghe Era revised the design: the altar was three chi high, one zhang three chi east to west and one zhang two chi north to south, with four outward stairways, one enclosure of twenty-five paces.

sentences.zh: 初，乾興祀靈星，值屠牲有禁，乃屠於城外。

translations.literal: At first, when sacrificing to the Spirit Star in Qianxing, slaughter fell on a forbidden day, so the animals were butchered outside the city.
translations.idiomatic: At first, when sacrificing to the Spirit Star in Qianxing, slaughter fell on a forbidden day, so the animals were butchered outside the city walls.

sentences.zh: 至是，敕有司：「凡祭祀牲牢，無避禁日，著為令。」

translations.literal: At this point an edict ordered the officials: "For all sacrificial livestock, do not avoid forbidden days — establish this as a regulation."
translations.idiomatic: At this point an edict ordered the officials: "For all sacrificial livestock, forbidden days shall not be observed — establish this as a regulation."

sentences.zh: 南渡後，靈星、壽星、風師、雨師、雷師及七祀、司寒、馬祖，並仍舊制。

translations.literal: After the southern relocation, the Spirit Star, Star of Longevity, Wind Master, Rain Master, Thunder Master, the seven sacrifices, the Director of Cold, and the Horse Ancestor all continued under the old regulations.
translations.idiomatic: After the move south, sacrifice to the Spirit Star, Star of Longevity, Wind Master, Rain Master, Thunder Master, the seven household sacrifices, the Director of Cold, and the Horse Ancestor all continued under the old regulations.

sentences.zh: 風伯、雨師，諸州亦致祭。

translations.literal: The Wind Earl and Rain Master were also sacrificed to in the various prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: The Wind Earl and Rain Master were also sacrificed to in the various prefectures.

sentences.zh: 大中祥符初，詔惟邊地要劇者，令通判致祭，餘皆長吏親享。

translations.literal: At the start of Dazhong Xiangfu, an edict ordered that only in critical border regions should the vice prefect perform the sacrifice; elsewhere the chief local official should preside in person.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of Dazhong Xiangfu, an edict ordered that only in critical border regions should the vice prefect perform the sacrifice; elsewhere the chief local official should preside in person.

sentences.zh: 未幾，澤州請立風伯、雨師廟，乃令禮官考儀式頒之。

translations.literal: Before long, Ze Prefecture requested the establishment of Wind Earl and Rain Master temples, and the ritual officials were ordered to examine the rites and promulgate them.
translations.idiomatic: Before long, Ze Prefecture requested temples to the Wind Earl and Rain Master, and the ritual officials were ordered to examine the rites and promulgate them.

sentences.zh: 有司言：「唐制，諸郡置風伯壇社壇之東，雨師壇於西，各稍北數十步，卑下於社壇。

translations.literal: The officials submitted: "Under Tang regulations, each commandery set a Wind Earl altar east of the soil altar and a Rain Master altar to the west, each slightly north by several tens of paces and lower than the soil altar.
translations.idiomatic: The officials reported: "Under Tang regulations, each commandery set a Wind Earl altar east of the soil altar and a Rain Master altar to the west, each slightly north by several tens of paces and lower than the soil altar.

sentences.zh: 祠用羊一，籩、豆各八，簠、簋各二。」

translations.literal: The sacrifice used one sheep, eight bian and eight dou each, and two fu and two gui each."
translations.idiomatic: The sacrifice used one sheep, eight bian and eight dou, and two fu and two gui."

sentences.zh: 元豐詳定局言：「《周禮》：'小宗伯之職，兆五帝於四郊，四類亦如之。」

translations.literal: The Yuanfeng Detailed Regulations Office submitted: "The Rites of Zhou: 'The Lesser Director of Sacrifices marks out the Five Thearchs at the four suburbs; the four categories are likewise marked out.'"
translations.idiomatic: The Yuanfeng Detailed Regulations Office reported: "The Rites of Zhou: 'The Lesser Director of Sacrifices marks out the Five Thearchs at the four suburbs; the four categories are likewise marked out.'"

sentences.zh: 鄭氏曰：'兆為壇之營域。

translations.literal: Master Zheng says: To mark out means to lay out the precinct of the altar.
translations.idiomatic: Master Zheng says: To mark out means to lay out the precinct of the altar.

sentences.zh: 四類，日、月、星、辰，運行無常，以氣類為之位，兆日於東郊，兆月與風師於西郊，兆司中、司命於南郊，兆雨師於北郊。

translations.literal: The four categories are sun, moon, stars, and constellations — their courses are not fixed, and seats are assigned by qi category: the sun is marked out at the eastern suburb, the moon and Wind Master at the western suburb, the Director of the Center and Director of Fate at the southern suburb, and the Rain Master at the northern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: The four categories are sun, moon, stars, and constellations — their courses are not fixed, and seats are assigned by qi category: the sun is marked out at the eastern suburb, the moon and Wind Master at the western suburb, the Director of the Center and Director of Fate at the southern suburb, and the Rain Master at the northern suburb.

sentences.zh: '各以氣類祭之，謂之四類。

translations.literal: Each is sacrificed to according to its qi category — this is called the four categories.
translations.idiomatic: Each is sacrificed to according to its qi category — this is called the four categories.

sentences.zh: 漢儀，縣邑常以丙戌日祠風伯于戌地，以己丑日祀雨師於醜地，亦從其類故也。

translations.literal: Han practice regularly sacrificed to the Wind Earl at the xu position on a bingxu day and to the Rain Master at the chou position on a jichou day — likewise following their categories.
translations.idiomatic: Han practice regularly sacrificed to the Wind Earl at the xu position on a bingxu day and to the Rain Master at the chou position on a jichou day — likewise following their categories.

sentences.zh: 熙寧祀儀：兆日東郊，兆月西郊，是以氣類為之位。

translations.literal: The Xining sacrificial regulations: the sun was marked out at the eastern suburb and the moon at the western suburb — assigning seats by qi category.
translations.idiomatic: The Xining sacrificial regulations marked out the sun at the eastern suburb and the moon at the western suburb — assigning seats by qi category.

sentences.zh: 至於兆風師于國城東北，兆雨師于國城西北，司中、司命于國城西北亥地，則是各從其星位，而不以氣類也。

translations.literal: But marking out the Wind Master northeast of the capital, the Rain Master northwest of the capital, and the Director of the Center and Director of Fate at the hai position northwest of the capital follows each star's position rather than qi category.
translations.idiomatic: But marking out the Wind Master northeast of the capital, the Rain Master northwest of the capital, and the Director of the Center and Director of Fate at the hai position northwest of the capital follows each star's position rather than qi category.

sentences.zh: 請稽舊禮，兆風師於西郊，祠以立春後醜日；

translations.literal: We request consultation of the old rites: mark out the Wind Master at the western suburb and sacrifice on a chou day after the Start of Spring;
translations.idiomatic: We ask that the old rites be consulted: mark out the Wind Master at the western suburb and sacrifice on a chou day after the Start of Spring;

sentences.zh: 兆雨師於北郊，祠以立夏後申日；

translations.literal: mark out the Rain Master at the northern suburb and sacrifice on a shen day after the Start of Summer;
translations.idiomatic: mark out the Rain Master at the northern suburb and sacrifice on a shen day after the Start of Summer;

sentences.zh: 兆司中、司命、司祿於南郊，祠以立冬後亥日。

translations.literal: mark out the Director of the Center, Director of Fate, and Director of Prosperity at the southern suburb and sacrifice on a hai day after the Start of Winter.
translations.idiomatic: mark out the Director of the Center, Director of Fate, and Director of Prosperity at the southern suburb and sacrifice on a hai day after the Start of Winter.

sentences.zh: 其壇兆則從其氣類，其祭辰則從其星位，仍依熙寧儀，以雷師從雨師之位，以司民從司中、司命、司祿之位。」

translations.literal: The altar sites should follow qi category, while the days of sacrifice should follow star positions; still following the Xining regulations, let the Thunder Master share the Rain Master's seat and the Director of the People share the seats of the Director of the Center, Director of Fate, and Director of Prosperity.
translations.idiomatic: The altar sites should follow qi category, while the days of sacrifice should follow star positions; still following the Xining regulations, let the Thunder Master share the Rain Master's seat and the Director of the People share the seats of the Director of the Center, Director of Fate, and Director of Prosperity.

sentences.zh: 舊制，風師壇高四尺，東西四步三尺，南北減一尺。

translations.literal: Under the old regulations, the Wind Master altar was four chi high, four paces three chi east to west, and one chi less north to south.
translations.idiomatic: Under the old regulations, the Wind Master altar was four chi high, four paces three chi east to west, and one chi less north to south.

sentences.zh: 皇祐定高三尺，週三十三步；

translations.literal: In Huangyou it was fixed at three chi high with a circumference of thirty-three paces;
translations.idiomatic: In Huangyou it was fixed at three chi high with a circumference of thirty-three paces;

sentences.zh: 雨師壇、雷師壇高三尺，方一丈九尺。

translations.literal: the Rain Master and Thunder Master altars were three chi high and one zhang nine chi square.
translations.idiomatic: the Rain Master and Thunder Master altars were three chi high and one zhang nine chi square.

sentences.zh: 皇祐定週六步。

translations.literal: In Huangyou the circumference was fixed at six paces.
translations.idiomatic: In Huangyou the circumference was fixed at six paces.

sentences.zh: 政和之制，風壇廣二十三步，雨、雷壇廣十五步，皆高三尺，四陛，並一壝，二十五步。

translations.literal: Under the Zhenghe regulations, the Wind altar was twenty-three paces across, the Rain and Thunder altars fifteen paces across, all three chi high with four stairways, each with one enclosure of twenty-five paces.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Zhenghe regulations, the Wind altar was twenty-three paces across, the Rain and Thunder altars fifteen paces across, all three chi high with four stairways, each with one enclosure of twenty-five paces.

sentences.zh: 其雨師、雷師二壇同壝。

translations.literal: The Rain Master and Thunder Master altars shared one enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: The Rain Master and Thunder Master altars shared one enclosure.

sentences.zh: 司中、司命、司民、司祿為四壇，各廣二十五步，同壝。

translations.literal: The Director of the Center, Director of Fate, Director of the People, and Director of Prosperity formed four altars, each twenty-five paces across, sharing one enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of the Center, Director of Fate, Director of the People, and Director of Prosperity formed four altars, each twenty-five paces across, sharing one enclosure.

sentences.zh: 又言：「《周禮》：'大宗伯以郐鍮燎祀司中、司命、風師、雨師。

translations.literal: They further submitted: "The Rites of Zhou: 'The Grand Director of Sacrifices uses a brazier of oak and catalpa to burn offerings in sacrifice to the Director of the Center, Director of Fate, Wind Master, and Rain Master.'
translations.idiomatic: They further reported: "The Rites of Zhou: 'The Grand Director of Sacrifices uses a brazier of oak and catalpa to burn offerings in sacrifice to the Director of the Center, Director of Fate, Wind Master, and Rain Master.'

sentences.zh: '所謂周人尚臭，升煙以報陽也。

translations.literal: This is what is meant by the Zhou people's esteem for fragrance — raising smoke to report to the yang.
translations.idiomatic: This is what is meant by the Zhou people's esteem for fragrance — raising smoke to report to the yang.

sentences.zh: 今天神之祀皆燔牲首，風師、雨師請用柏柴升煙，以為歆神之始。」

translations.literal: Today sacrifices to celestial deities all burn the heads of victims; for the Wind Master and Rain Master we request the use of cypress and firewood to raise smoke, as the beginning of pleasing the spirits."
translations.idiomatic: Today sacrifices to celestial deities all burn the heads of victims; for the Wind Master and Rain Master we request the use of cypress and firewood to raise smoke, as the opening act of pleasing the spirits."

sentences.zh: 又言：「《周禮》樂師之職曰：'凡國之小事用樂者，令奏鐘鼓。

translations.literal: They further submitted: "The Rites of Zhou, in the duties of the Master of Music, says: 'For all minor state affairs requiring music, order the bells and drums to be played.'
translations.idiomatic: They further reported: "The Rites of Zhou, in the duties of the Master of Music, says: 'For all minor state affairs requiring music, order the bells and drums to be played.'

sentences.zh: '說者曰：'小祀也。

translations.literal: Commentators say: 'Minor sacrifices.'
translations.idiomatic: Commentators say: 'Minor sacrifices.'

sentences.zh: '小師職《注》：'小祭祀謂司中、司命、風師。

translations.literal: The commentary on the duties of the Lesser Master of Music: 'Minor sacrifices mean the Director of the Center, Director of Fate, and Wind Master.'
translations.idiomatic: The commentary on the duties of the Lesser Master of Music: 'Minor sacrifices mean the Director of the Center, Director of Fate, and Wind Master.'

sentences.zh: '是也。

translations.literal: This is correct.
translations.idiomatic: This is correct.

sentences.zh: 既已有鐘鼓，則是有樂明矣。

translations.literal: Since bells and drums are already prescribed, music is clearly required.
translations.idiomatic: Since bells and drums are already prescribed, music is clearly required.

sentences.zh: 請有司祀司中、司命、風師、雨師用樂，仍制樂章以為降神之節。」

translations.literal: We request that the officials use music when sacrificing to the Director of the Center, Director of Fate, Wind Master, and Rain Master, and compose hymn texts to serve as the cadence for the descent of the spirits."
translations.idiomatic: We ask that the officials use music when sacrificing to the Director of the Center, Director of Fate, Wind Master, and Rain Master, and compose hymn texts to serve as the cadence for the descent of the spirits."

sentences.zh: 又言：「《周禮》小司徒之職：'凡小祭祀奉牛牲羞其肆。

translations.literal: They further submitted: "The Rites of Zhou, in the duties of the Lesser Director of the People: 'For all minor sacrifices present bovine victims and offer their dismembered portions.'
translations.idiomatic: They further reported: "The Rites of Zhou, in the duties of the Lesser Director of the People: 'For all minor sacrifices present bovine victims and offer their dismembered portions.'

sentences.zh: '又《肆師》云：'小祭祀用牲。

translations.literal: The Director of Arrangements also says: 'Minor sacrifices use victims.'
translations.idiomatic: The Director of Arrangements also says: 'Minor sacrifices use victims.'

sentences.zh: '所謂小祭祀，即司中、司命、司民、司祿、宮中七祀之類是也。

translations.literal: What are called minor sacrifices are the Director of the Center, Director of Fate, Director of the People, Director of Prosperity, the seven palace sacrifices, and the like.
translations.idiomatic: What are called minor sacrifices are the Director of the Center, Director of Fate, Director of the People, Director of Prosperity, the seven palace sacrifices, and the like.

sentences.zh: 後世以有司攝事，難於純用太牢，猶宜下同大夫禮，用羊、豕可也。

translations.literal: In later ages, because officials performed the rites by proxy, it was difficult to use the full great victim exclusively; still, following the rites of a lower grandee, sheep and swine would suffice.
translations.idiomatic: In later ages, because officials performed the rites by proxy, it was difficult to use the full great victim exclusively; still, following the rites of a lower grandee, sheep and swine would suffice.

sentences.zh: 今祀儀，馬祖、先牧、司中、司命、司民、司祿、司寒，歲用羊、豕一。

translations.literal: Under the present sacrificial regulations, the Horse Ancestor, Former Shepherd, Director of the Center, Director of Fate, Director of the People, Director of Prosperity, and Director of Cold each year use one sheep and one swine.
translations.idiomatic: Under the present sacrificial regulations, the Horse Ancestor, Former Shepherd, Director of the Center, Director of Fate, Director of the People, Director of Prosperity, and Director of Cold each year use one sheep and one swine.

sentences.zh: 《祠令》：小祠，牲入滌一月，所以備潔養之法。

translations.literal: The Sacrifice Regulations: for minor sacrifices, victims enter the cleansing pen one month beforehand, to fulfill the rules of purification and tending.
translations.idiomatic: The Sacrifice Regulations: for minor sacrifices, victims enter the cleansing pen one month beforehand, to fulfill the rules of purification and tending.

sentences.zh: 今每位肉以豕，又取諸市，與令文相戾。

translations.literal: Now each seat uses swine flesh purchased from the market — this conflicts with the text of the regulations.
translations.idiomatic: Now each seat uses swine flesh purchased from the market — this conflicts with the text of the regulations.

sentences.zh: 請諸小祠祭以少牢，仍用體解。」

translations.literal: We request that all minor sacrifices use the lesser victim and still employ whole dismemberment."
translations.idiomatic: We ask that all minor sacrifices use the lesser victim and still employ whole dismemberment."

sentences.zh: 又言：「社稷五祀，先薦爓，次薦熟；

translations.literal: They further submitted: "For the soil and grain and the five sacrifices, raw offerings are presented first, then cooked offerings;
translations.idiomatic: They further reported: "For the soil and grain and the five sacrifices, raw offerings are presented first, then cooked offerings;

sentences.zh: 至於群小祀，薦熟而已。

translations.literal: as for the various minor sacrifices, only cooked offerings are presented.
translations.idiomatic: as for the various minor sacrifices, only cooked offerings are presented.

sentences.zh: 請四方百物、宮中七祠、司中、司命、風師、雨師止薦熟。」

translations.literal: We request that the hundred things of the four directions, the seven palace shrines, the Director of the Center, Director of Fate, Wind Master, and Rain Master present only cooked offerings."
translations.idiomatic: We ask that the hundred things of the four directions, the seven palace shrines, the Director of the Center, Director of Fate, Wind Master, and Rain Master present only cooked offerings."

sentences.zh: 並從之。

translations.literal: All were approved.
translations.idiomatic: All were approved.

sentences.zh: 司寒之祭，常以四月，命官率太祝，用牲、幣及黑牡、秬黍祭玄冥之神，乃開冰以薦太廟。

translations.literal: Sacrifice to the Director of Cold was regularly held in the fourth month; an official was ordered to lead the Grand Invoker, using victims, silks, a black bull, and black millet to sacrifice to the Dark Mystery spirit, then open the ice store to present ice to the Grand Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: Sacrifice to the Director of Cold was regularly held in the fourth month; an official was ordered to lead the Grand Invoker, using victims, silks, a black bull, and black millet to sacrifice to the Dark Mystery spirit, then open the ice store to present ice to the Grand Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 建隆二年，置藏冰署而修其祀焉。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jianlong, an Ice Store Office was established and its sacrifice restored.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Jianlong, an Ice Store Office was established and its sacrifice restored.

sentences.zh: 秘書監李至言：「案《詩·豳·七月》曰：'四之日獻羔祭韭。

translations.literal: Director of the Secretariat Li Zhi submitted: "According to the Odes of Bin, 'Seventh Month': 'On the fourth month-day present a lamb and sacrifice leeks.'
translations.idiomatic: Director of the Secretariat Li Zhi reported: "According to the Odes of Bin, 'Seventh Month': 'On the fourth month-day present a lamb and sacrifice leeks.'

sentences.zh: '蓋謂周以十一月為正，其四月即今之二月也。

translations.literal: This means that Zhou took the eleventh month as the first month, so its fourth month is our second month.
translations.idiomatic: This means that Zhou took the eleventh month as the first month, so its fourth month is our second month.

sentences.zh: 《春秋傳》曰：'日在北陸而藏冰。

translations.literal: The Spring and Autumn Commentary says: 'When the sun is in Northern Ascent, ice is stored.'
translations.idiomatic: The Spring and Autumn Commentary says: 'When the sun is in Northern Ascent, ice is stored.'

sentences.zh: '謂夏十二月，日在危也。

translations.literal: This means the twelfth month of Xia, when the sun is in Wei.
translations.idiomatic: This means the twelfth month of Xia, when the sun is in Wei.

sentences.zh: '獻羔而啟之'，謂二月春分，獻羔祭韭，始開冰室也。

translations.literal: 'Present the lamb and open it' means at the spring equinox of the second month, presenting a lamb and sacrificing leeks — the time when the ice chamber is first opened.
translations.idiomatic: 'Present the lamb and open it' means at the spring equinox of the second month, presenting a lamb and sacrificing leeks — the time when the ice chamber is first opened.

sentences.zh: '火出而畢賦'，火星昏見，謂四月中也。

translations.literal: 'When the Fire star appears and the levy is complete,' Mars appearing at dusk means the fourth month.
translations.idiomatic: 'When the Fire star appears and the levy is complete,' Mars appearing at dusk means the fourth month.

sentences.zh: 又案《月令》：'天子獻羔開冰，先薦寢廟。

translations.literal: Further examining the Monthly Ordinances: 'The Son of Heaven presents a lamb and opens the ice store, first presenting it to the resting temple.
translations.idiomatic: Further examining the Monthly Ordinances: 'The Son of Heaven presents a lamb and opens the ice store, first presenting it to the resting temple.

sentences.zh: '詳其開冰之祭，當在春分，乃有司之失也。」

translations.literal: Examining the opening-ice sacrifice in detail, it ought to fall at the spring equinox — the error lies with the officials."
translations.idiomatic: Examining the opening-ice sacrifice in detail, it ought to fall at the spring equinox — the error lies with the officials."

sentences.zh: 帝覽奏，曰：「今四月，韭可苫屋矣，何謂薦新？」

translations.literal: The Emperor read the memorial and said: "It is now the fourth month — leeks can already thatch a roof. What is meant by presenting the new?"
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor read the memorial and said: "It is now the fourth month — leeks can already thatch a roof. What is meant by presenting the new?"

sentences.zh: 遂正其禮。

translations.literal: The rite was then corrected.
translations.idiomatic: The rite was then corrected.

sentences.zh: 天聖新令：「春分陰冰，祭司寒于冰井務，卜日薦冰於太廟。

translations.literal: The new regulations of Tiansheng: "At the spring equinox, yin ice is stored; sacrifice to the Director of Cold is made at the Ice Well Office; an auspicious day is chosen to present ice to the Grand Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: The new regulations of Tiansheng: "At the spring equinox, yin ice is stored; sacrifice to the Director of Cold is made at the Ice Well Office; an auspicious day is chosen to present ice to the Grand Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 季冬藏冰，設祭亦如之。」

translations.literal: In the last month of winter ice is stored, and sacrifices are set up likewise."
translations.idiomatic: In the last month of winter ice is stored, and sacrifices are set up likewise."

sentences.zh: 元豐，詳定所言：「熙甯祀儀，孟冬選吉日祀司寒。

translations.literal: In the Yuanfeng era, the Directorate of Detailed Review submitted: "Under the sacrificial regulations of Xining, an auspicious day in early winter was chosen to sacrifice to the Director of Cold.
translations.idiomatic: In the Yuanfeng era, the Directorate of Detailed Review reported: "Under the sacrificial regulations of Xining, an auspicious day in early winter was chosen to sacrifice to the Director of Cold.

sentences.zh: 按古享司寒，惟以藏冰啟冰之日，孟冬非有事於冰，則不應祭享。

translations.literal: According to antiquity, sacrifice to the Director of Cold was made only on the days of storing and opening ice; early winter has no business with ice, and therefore ought not to receive sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: According to antiquity, sacrifice to the Director of Cold was made only on the days of storing and opening ice; early winter has no business with ice, and therefore ought not to receive sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 今請惟季冬藏冰則享司寒，牲用黑牡羊，谷用黑秬黍。

translations.literal: We now request that only when ice is stored in the last month of winter should the Director of Cold be honored, using a black ram as victim and black millet as grain.
translations.idiomatic: We now ask that only when ice is stored in the last month of winter should the Director of Cold be honored, using a black ram as victim and black millet as grain.

sentences.zh: 仲春開冰，則但用羔。

translations.literal: When ice is opened in mid-spring, only a lamb is used.
translations.idiomatic: When ice is opened in mid-spring, only a lamb is used.

sentences.zh: 孔穎達注《月令》曰：'藏冰則用牡黍，啟唯告而已。

translations.literal: Kong Yingda's commentary on the Monthly Ordinances says: 'When ice is stored, a bull and millet are used; when it is opened, only a proclamation is made.'
translations.idiomatic: Kong Yingda's commentary on the Monthly Ordinances says: 'When ice is stored, a bull and millet are used; when it is opened, only a proclamation is made.'

sentences.zh: '祭禮大、告禮小故也。

translations.literal: The sacrificial rite is great, the proclamation rite is small — hence this difference.
translations.idiomatic: The sacrificial rite is great, the proclamation rite is small — hence this difference.

sentences.zh: 且開冰將以禦至尊，當有桃弧、棘矢以禳除凶邪。

translations.literal: Moreover, opening ice is to serve the utmost honored; there ought to be peach bow and thorn arrows to exorcise evil influences.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, opening ice is to serve the Son of Heaven; there ought to be peach bow and thorn arrows to exorcise evil influences.

sentences.zh: 設於神坐，則非禮也。

translations.literal: To set them on the spirit seat would not be ritually correct.
translations.idiomatic: To set them on the spirit seat would not be ritually correct.

sentences.zh: 當從孔氏說，出冰之時，置弓矢于淩室之戶。」

translations.literal: One should follow Kong's interpretation: when ice is taken out, place the bow and arrows at the door of the ice chamber."
translations.idiomatic: One should follow Kong's interpretation: when ice is taken out, place the bow and arrows at the door of the ice chamber."

sentences.zh: 大觀，禮局言：「《春秋左氏傳》，以少昊有四叔，其二為玄冥。

translations.literal: In the Daguan era, the Ritual Bureau submitted: "In the Zuo Commentary to the Spring and Autumn Annals, it is said that Shaohao had four uncles, two of whom were Xuanming.
translations.idiomatic: In the Daguan era, the Ritual Bureau reported: "In the Zuo Commentary to the Spring and Autumn Annals, it is said that Shaohao had four uncles, two of whom were Xuanming.

sentences.zh: 杜預、鄭玄皆以玄冥為水官，故歷代祀為司寒，則玄冥非天神矣。

translations.literal: Du Yu and Zheng Xuan both took Xuanming as the water official; therefore the generations sacrificed to him as Director of Cold — Xuanming is not a celestial deity.
translations.idiomatic: Du Yu and Zheng Xuan both took Xuanming as the water official; therefore the generations sacrificed to him as Director of Cold — Xuanming is not a celestial deity.

sentences.zh: 今儀注，禮畢有司取祝幣瘞坎，贊者贊幣燔燎，是以祀天神之禮享人鬼也。

translations.literal: Under the present ritual manual, after the rite is complete the officials take the invocation silks and bury them in the pit, while the assistant burns the silks — this applies the rite for celestial deities to human spirits.
translations.idiomatic: Under the present ritual manual, after the rite is complete the officials take the invocation silks and bury them in the pit, while the assistant burns the silks — this applies the rite for celestial deities to human spirits.

sentences.zh: 請罷燔燎而埋祝幣。」

translations.literal: We request that the burning be abolished and the invocation silks buried."
translations.idiomatic: We ask that the burning be abolished and the invocation silks buried."

sentences.zh: 詔從其請。

translations.literal: An edict approved the request.
translations.idiomatic: An edict approved the request.

sentences.zh: 大蠟之禮，自魏以來始定議。

translations.literal: The great la sacrifice was first given settled discussion from Wei onward.
translations.idiomatic: The great la sacrifice was first given settled discussion from Wei onward.

sentences.zh: 王者各隨其行，社以其盛，臘以其終。

translations.literal: Each ruler followed his own element: the soil altars at the height of the season, la at its end.
translations.idiomatic: Each ruler followed his own element: the soil altars at the height of the season, la at its end.

sentences.zh: 建隆初，以有司言：「周木德，木生火，宜以火德王，色尚赤。」

translations.literal: At the beginning of Jianlong, on the officials' report: "Zhou possessed the Wood Virtue; wood generates fire — one ought to rule by the Fire Virtue and favor the color red."
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Jianlong, on the officials' report: "Zhou possessed the Wood Virtue; wood generates fire — one ought to rule by the Fire Virtue and favor the color red."

sentences.zh: 遂以戌日為臘。

translations.literal: The day xu was therefore made la day.
translations.idiomatic: The day xu was therefore made la day.

sentences.zh: 三年，戊戌臘，有司畫日，以七日辛卯。

translations.literal: In the third year, on the wuxu la day, the officials fixed the calendar and set the seventh day, xinmao.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, on the wuxu la day, the officials fixed the calendar and set the seventh day, xinmao.

sentences.zh: 和峴奏議曰：「按蠟始于伊耆，後曆三代及漢，其名雖改，而其實一也。

translations.literal: He Xian's memorial argued: "La originated with Yixi; thereafter through the Three Dynasties and Han its name changed but its substance was one.
translations.idiomatic: He Xian's memorial argued: "La originated with Yixi; thereafter through the Three Dynasties and Han its name changed but its substance was one.

sentences.zh: 漢火行，用戌臘，臘者接也，新故相接，畋獵禽獸以享百神，報終成之功也。

translations.literal: Han followed the Fire Virtue and used xu for la; la means 'joining' — old and new joining — hunting beasts and birds to feast the hundred spirits, reporting the completion of the year's work.
translations.idiomatic: Han followed the Fire Virtue and used xu for la; la means 'joining' — old and new joining — hunting beasts and birds to feast the hundred spirits, reporting the completion of the year's work.

sentences.zh: 王者因之，上享宗廟，旁及五祀，展其孝心，盡物示恭也。

translations.literal: Rulers followed this, first feasting the ancestral temple, then extending to the five sacrifices, displaying filial heart and showing reverence through full offerings.
translations.idiomatic: Rulers followed this, first feasting the ancestral temple, then extending to the five sacrifices, displaying filial heart and showing reverence through full offerings.

sentences.zh: 魏、晉以降，悉沿其制。

translations.literal: From Wei and Jin downward, all followed this system.
translations.idiomatic: From Wei and Jin downward, all followed this system.

sentences.zh: 唐乘土德，貞觀之際，以前寅日蠟百神，卯日祭社宮，辰日享宗廟。

translations.literal: Tang possessed the Earth Virtue; at the Zhenguan era, on the day before yin la spirits were sacrificed, on mao the soil altars were sacrificed, on chen the ancestral temple was feasted.
translations.idiomatic: Tang possessed the Earth Virtue; at the Zhenguan era, on the day before yin la spirits were sacrificed, on mao the soil altars were sacrificed, on chen the ancestral temple was feasted.

sentences.zh: 開元定禮，三祭皆於臘辰，以應土德。

translations.literal: The Kaiyuan ritual code fixed all three sacrifices on the chen day of la, matching the Earth Virtue.
translations.idiomatic: The Kaiyuan ritual code fixed all three sacrifices on the chen day of la, matching the Earth Virtue.

sentences.zh: 今以戌日為臘，而以前七日辛卯行蠟禮，恐未為宜。

translations.literal: Now xu is taken as la day, yet the la rite is performed seven days earlier on xinmao — this is probably not appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: Now xu is taken as la day, yet the la rite is performed seven days earlier on xinmao — this is probably not appropriate.

sentences.zh: 況宗廟、社稷並遵臘享，獨蠟不以臘，請下禮官議。」

translations.literal: Moreover, the ancestral temple and soil altars both follow la for feasting, yet la alone does not use la day — we request that ritual officials be instructed to deliberate."
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, the ancestral temple and soil altars both follow la for feasting, yet la alone does not use la day — we ask that ritual officials be instructed to deliberate."

sentences.zh: 議如峴言，今後蠟百神、祀社稷、享宗廟皆用戌臘一日。

translations.literal: The deliberation followed He Xian's proposal: henceforth la spirits, soil altars, and ancestral temple feasting all use the single wuxu la day.
translations.idiomatic: The deliberation followed He Xian's proposal: henceforth la spirits, soil altars, and ancestral temple feasting all use the single wuxu la day.

sentences.zh: 天聖三年，同知禮院陳詁言：「蠟祭一百九十二位，祝文內載一百八十二位，唯五方田畯、五方郵表曻叕一十位不載祝文。

translations.literal: In the third year of Tiansheng, Vice Director of the Ritual Academy Chen Gu submitted: "The la sacrifice has one hundred ninety-two seats; the invocation text records one hundred eighty-two — only the field overseers of the five directions and the ten directional postal boundary spirits are not recorded in the invocation text.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Tiansheng, Vice Director Chen Gu of the Ritual Academy reported: "The la sacrifice has one hundred ninety-two seats; the invocation text records one hundred eighty-two — only the field overseers of the five directions and the ten directional postal boundary spirits are not recorded in the invocation text.

sentences.zh: 又《郊祀錄》、《正辭錄》、《司天監神位圖》皆以虎為於菟，乃避唐諱，請仍為虎。

translations.literal: Further, the Suburban Sacrifice Records, Correct Invocation Records, and Directorate of Astronomy spirit-seat charts all use yutu for tiger — this avoids Tang taboo; we request that it remain 'tiger.'
translations.idiomatic: Further, the Suburban Sacrifice Records, Correct Invocation Records, and Directorate of Astronomy spirit-seat charts all use yutu for tiger — this avoids Tang taboo; we ask that it remain 'tiger.'

sentences.zh: 五方祝文，眾族之下增入田畯、郵表畷雲。」

translations.literal: In the invocation texts of the five directions, under the various clans add the field overseer and postal boundary spirits."
translations.idiomatic: In the invocation texts of the five directions, under the various clans add the field overseer and postal boundary spirits."

sentences.zh: 元豐，詳定所言：「《記》曰：'八蠟以祀四方，年不順成，八蠟不通。

translations.literal: In the Yuanfeng era, the Directorate of Detailed Review submitted: "The Record says: 'The eight la to sacrifice to the four directions — if the year is not fully successful, the eight la are not performed.'
translations.idiomatic: In the Yuanfeng era, the Directorate of Detailed Review reported: "The Record says: 'The eight la to sacrifice to the four directions — if the year is not fully successful, the eight la are not performed.'

sentences.zh: '歷代蠟祭，獨在南郊為一壇，惟周、隋四郊之兆，乃合禮意。

translations.literal: Through the generations the la sacrifice alone was held at one altar in the southern suburb; only Zhou and Sui had precincts at the four suburbs — this accords with ritual meaning.
translations.idiomatic: Through the generations the la sacrifice alone was held at one altar in the southern suburb; only Zhou and Sui had precincts at the four suburbs — this accords with ritual meaning.

sentences.zh: 又《禮記·月令》以蠟與息民為二祭，故隋、唐息民祭在蠟之後日。

translations.literal: Further, the Monthly Ordinances in the Book of Rites treat la and the Rest-the-People sacrifice as two separate rites; therefore in Sui and Tang the Rest-the-People sacrifice fell on the day after la.
translations.idiomatic: Further, the Monthly Ordinances in the Book of Rites treat la and the Rest-the-People sacrifice as two separate rites; therefore in Sui and Tang the Rest-the-People sacrifice fell on the day after la.

sentences.zh: 請蠟祭，四郊各為一壇，以祀其方之神，有不順成之方則不修報。

translations.literal: We request that the la sacrifice set up one altar at each of the four suburbs to sacrifice to the spirits of each direction; if a direction's year was not fully successful, no report-sacrifice is performed there.
translations.idiomatic: We ask that the la sacrifice set up one altar at each of the four suburbs to sacrifice to the spirits of each direction; if a direction's year was not fully successful, no report-sacrifice is performed there.

sentences.zh: 其息民祭仍在蠟祭之後。」

translations.literal: The Rest-the-People sacrifice should still follow the la sacrifice."
translations.idiomatic: The Rest-the-People sacrifice should still follow the la sacrifice."

sentences.zh: 先是，太常寺言：「四郊蠟祭，宜依百神制度築壇，其東西有不順成之方，即祭日月。

translations.literal: Earlier, the Court of Imperial Sacrifices submitted: "The la sacrifice at the four suburbs should build altars according to the system for the hundred spirits; if east or west had a direction whose year was not fully successful, sacrifice to the sun and moon.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, the Court of Imperial Sacrifices reported: "The la sacrifice at the four suburbs should build altars according to the system for the hundred spirits; if east or west had a direction whose year was not fully successful, sacrifice to the sun and moon.

sentences.zh: 其神農以下，更不設祭。

translations.literal: For Shennong and those below, no further altars should be set up.
translations.idiomatic: For Shennong and those below, no further altars should be set up.

sentences.zh: 又舊儀，神農、後稷並設位壇下，當移壇上。

translations.literal: Further, under the old regulations Shennong and Houji both had seats below the altar and ought to be moved above it.
translations.idiomatic: Further, under the old regulations Shennong and Houji both had seats below the altar and ought to be moved above it.

sentences.zh: 按《禮記正義》：伊耆氏，神農也。

translations.literal: According to the Correct Meaning of the Book of Rites: Yixi is Shennong.
translations.idiomatic: According to the Correct Meaning of the Book of Rites: Yixi is Shennong.

sentences.zh: 今壇下更設伊耆氏位，合除去之。」

translations.literal: Now a seat for Yixi is additionally set below the altar — it should be removed."
translations.idiomatic: Now a seat for Yixi is additionally set below the altar — it should be removed."

sentences.zh: 《政和新儀》：臘前一日蠟百神。

translations.literal: The Political Harmony New Ritual Manual: on the day before la, la spirits are sacrificed.
translations.idiomatic: The Political Harmony New Ritual Manual: on the day before la, la spirits are sacrificed.

sentences.zh: 四方蠟壇廣四丈，高八尺，四出陛，兩壝，每壝二十五步。

translations.literal: The la altars of the four directions are four zhang across and eight chi high, with four outward stairways and two enclosures, each enclosure twenty-five paces.
translations.idiomatic: The la altars of the four directions are four zhang across and eight chi high, with four outward stairways and two enclosures, each enclosure twenty-five paces.

sentences.zh: 東方設大明位，西方設夜明位，以神農氏、後稷氏配，配位以北為上。

translations.literal: The east sets the Great Brightness seat, the west the Night Brightness seat, with Shennong and Houji as paired deities; for paired seats, north takes precedence.
translations.idiomatic: The east sets the Great Brightness seat, the west the Night Brightness seat, with Shennong and Houji as paired deities; for paired seats, north takes precedence.

sentences.zh: 南北壇設神農位，以後稷配，五星、二十八宿、十二辰、五官、五嶽、五鎮、四海、四瀆及五方山林、川澤、丘陵、墳衍、原隰、井泉、田畯，倉龍、朱鳥、麒麟、白虎、玄武，五水庸、五坊、五虎、五鱗、五羽、五介、五毛、五郵表畷、五臝、五貓、五昆蟲從祀，各依其方設位。

translations.literal: The southern and northern altars set a Shennong seat, with Houji paired; the five stars, twenty-eight lunar mansions, twelve chronograms, five officials, five sacred mountains, five guardian peaks, the four seas, four great rivers, and the five directions' mountains and forests, streams and marshes, hills and mounds, burial mounds and open flats, plains and lowlands, wells and springs, and field overseers; Azure Dragon, Vermilion Bird, Qilin, White Tiger, and Dark Warrior; the five water dikes, five pens, five tigers, five scaly creatures, five feathered creatures, five shelled creatures, five furred creatures, five postal boundary spirits, five naked creatures, five cats, and five insects — all as associated sacrifices, each seat set according to its direction.
translations.idiomatic: The southern and northern altars set a Shennong seat, with Houji paired; the five stars, twenty-eight lunar mansions, twelve chronograms, five officials, five sacred mountains, five guardian peaks, the four seas, four great rivers, and the five directions' mountains and forests, streams and marshes, hills and mounds, burial mounds and open flats, plains and lowlands, wells and springs, and field overseers; Azure Dragon, Vermilion Bird, Qilin, White Tiger, and Dark Warrior; the five water dikes, five pens, five tigers, five scaly creatures, five feathered creatures, five shelled creatures, five furred creatures, five postal boundary spirits, five naked creatures, five cats, and five insects — all as associated sacrifices, each seat set according to its direction.

sentences.zh: 中方鎮星、後土、田畯設於南方蠟壇酉階之西，中方嶽鎮以下設於南方蠟壇午階之西。

translations.literal: The Central Region's Chronogram Star, Queen Earth, and Field Overseer are set west of the you stair of the southern la altar; Central Region mountain-lords and below are set west of the wu stair of the southern la altar.
translations.idiomatic: The Central Region's Chronogram Star, Queen Earth, and Field Overseer are set west of the you stair of the southern la altar; Central Region mountain-lords and below are set west of the wu stair of the southern la altar.

sentences.zh: 伊耆設於北方蠟壇卯階之南，其位次於辰星。

translations.literal: Yixi is set south of the mao stair of the northern la altar, his seat ranking after the Chronogram of Chen star.
translations.idiomatic: Yixi is set south of the mao stair of the northern la altar, his seat ranking after the Chronogram of Chen star.

sentences.zh: 紹興十九年，有司檢會《五禮新儀》，臘前一日蠟東方、西方為大祀，蠟南方、北方為中祀，並用牲牢。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year of Shaoxing, the officials collated the New Ritual Manual of the Five Rites: on the day before la, la of east and west were great sacrifices, la of south and north were medium sacrifices, all using full victims.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year of Shaoxing, the officials collated the New Ritual Manual of the Five Rites: on the day before la, la of east and west were great sacrifices, la of south and north were medium sacrifices, all using full victims.

sentences.zh: 乾道四年，太常少卿王瀹又請於四郊各為一壇，以祀其方之神，東西以日月為主，各以神農、後稷配；

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Qiandao, Vice Director Wang Yue of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices again requested one altar at each of the four suburbs to sacrifice to the spirits of each direction; east and west take sun and moon as principal deities, each paired with Shennong and Houji;
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Qiandao, Vice Director Wang Yue of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices again requested one altar at each of the four suburbs to sacrifice to the spirits of each direction; east and west take sun and moon as principal deities, each paired with Shennong and Houji;

sentences.zh: 南北皆以神農為主，以後稷配。

translations.literal: north and south both take Shennong as principal deity, with Houji paired.
translations.idiomatic: north and south both take Shennong as principal deity, with Houji paired.

sentences.zh: 自五帝、星辰、嶽鎮、海瀆以至貓虎、昆蟲，各隨其方，分為從祀。

translations.literal: From the Five Emperors, stars, mountain-lords, seas and rivers down to cats, tigers, and insects — each follows its direction as associated sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: From the Five Emperors, stars, mountain-lords, seas and rivers down to cats, tigers, and insects — each follows its direction as associated sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 其後南蠟仍於圓壇望祭殿，北蠟于余杭門外精進寺行禮。

translations.literal: Thereafter southern la was still performed at the Round Altar Distancing-Sacrifice Hall; northern la was performed at Jingjin Temple outside Yuhang Gate.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter southern la was still performed at the Round Altar Distancing-Sacrifice Hall; northern la was performed at Jingjin Temple outside Yuhang Gate.

sentences.zh: 太廟司命、戶、灶、中霤、門、厲、行七祀，熙寧八年，始置位版。

translations.literal: The seven sacrifices of the Grand Ancestral Temple — Director of Fate, Household Door, Stove, Inner Court, Gate, Plague, and Travel — in the eighth year of Xining, seat tablets were first set up.
translations.idiomatic: The seven sacrifices of the Grand Ancestral Temple — Director of Fate, Household Door, Stove, Inner Court, Gate, Plague, and Travel — in the eighth year of Xining, seat tablets were first set up.

sentences.zh: 太常禮院請禘享遍祭七祀。

translations.literal: The Ritual Academy of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices requested that the di and xia feasts sacrifice to all seven throughout.
translations.idiomatic: The Ritual Academy of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices requested that the di and xia feasts sacrifice to all seven throughout.

sentences.zh: 詳定所言：「《周禮》：天子六服，自拎冕而下，各隨所祭而服。

translations.literal: The detailed regulations office stated: "The Rites of Zhou: the Son of Heaven has six kinds of dress, from the dark crown downward, each worn according to what is sacrificed to.
translations.idiomatic: The detailed regulations office stated: "The Rites of Zhou: the Son of Heaven has six kinds of dress, from the dark ceremonial crown downward, each worn according to what is sacrificed to.

sentences.zh: 今既不親祀，則諸臣攝事日，當從王所祭之服，其攝事之臣不系其官。」

translations.literal: Now since the emperor does not sacrifice in person, on days when officials stand in, they should wear the dress corresponding to what the king sacrifices to; the standing-in official is not bound by his office."
translations.idiomatic: Now since the emperor does not sacrifice in person, on days when officials stand in, they should wear the dress corresponding to what the king sacrifices to; the standing-in official is not bound by his office."

sentences.zh: 又言：「《禮·祭法》曰：'王自為立七祀：曰司命，曰中霤，曰國行，曰泰厲，曰門，曰戶，曰灶。

translations.literal: They further submitted: "The Book of Rites on Sacrifice says: 'The king establishes seven sacrifices for himself: Director of Fate, Inner Court, State Travel, Great Plague, Gate, Door, and Stove.
translations.idiomatic: They further reported: "The Book of Rites on Sacrifice says: 'The king establishes seven sacrifices for himself: Director of Fate, Inner Court, State Travel, Great Plague, Gate, Door, and Stove.

sentences.zh: '孟春祀戶，祭先脾；

translations.literal: In the first month of spring sacrifice to the Door, offering the spleen first;
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring sacrifice to the Door, offering the spleen first;

sentences.zh: 孟夏祀灶。

translations.literal: In the first month of summer sacrifice to the Stove.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of summer sacrifice to the Stove.

sentences.zh: 祭先肺；

translations.literal: Offering the lungs first;
translations.idiomatic: Offering the lungs first;

sentences.zh: 中央土祀中霤，祭先心；

translations.literal: At the central earth sacrifice to the Inner Court, offering the heart first;
translations.idiomatic: At the central earth sacrifice to the Inner Court, offering the heart first;

sentences.zh: 孟秋祀門，祭先肝；

translations.literal: In the first month of autumn sacrifice to the Gate, offering the liver first;
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of autumn sacrifice to the Gate, offering the liver first;

sentences.zh: 孟冬祀行，祭先腎。

translations.literal: In the first month of winter sacrifice to Travel, offering the kidneys first.'
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of winter sacrifice to Travel, offering the kidneys first.'

sentences.zh: 又《傳》曰：'春祀司命，秋祠厲。

translations.literal: Further, the Commentary says: 'In spring sacrifice to the Director of Fate; in autumn sacrifice to Plague.'
translations.idiomatic: Further, the Commentary says: 'In spring sacrifice to the Director of Fate; in autumn sacrifice to Plague.'

sentences.zh: '此所祀之位，所祀之時，所用之俎也。

translations.literal: These are the seats sacrificed to, the seasons of sacrifice, and the trays used.
translations.idiomatic: These are the seats sacrificed to, the seasons of sacrifice, and the trays used.

sentences.zh: 《周禮》：'司服掌王之吉服，祭群小祀則服玄冕。

translations.literal: The Rites of Zhou: 'The Director of Robes manages the king's auspicious dress; for sacrifice to the minor spirits he wears the dark crown.'
translations.idiomatic: The Rites of Zhou: 'The Director of Robes manages the king's auspicious dress; for sacrifice to the minor spirits he wears the dark crown.'

sentences.zh: '《注》謂宮中七祀之屬。

translations.literal: The commentary refers to the seven palace sacrifices and the like.
translations.idiomatic: The commentary refers to the seven palace sacrifices and the like.

sentences.zh: 《禮記》曰：'一獻熟。

translations.literal: The Book of Rites says: 'One presentation of cooked offering.'
translations.idiomatic: The Book of Rites says: 'One presentation of cooked offering.'

sentences.zh: '《注》謂宮中群小神七祀之等。

translations.literal: The commentary refers to the minor palace spirits and the seven sacrifices and the like.
translations.idiomatic: The commentary refers to the minor palace spirits and the seven sacrifices and the like.

sentences.zh: 《周禮·大宗伯》：'若王不與祭祀則攝位。

translations.literal: The Rites of Zhou, Grand Invocator: 'If the king does not attend the sacrifice, then another stands in his place.'
translations.idiomatic: The Rites of Zhou, Grand Invocator: 'If the king does not attend the sacrifice, then another stands in his place.'

sentences.zh: '此所祀之服，所獻之禮，所攝之官也。

translations.literal: These are the dress for sacrifice, the offerings presented, and the office standing in.
translations.idiomatic: These are the dress for sacrifice, the offerings presented, and the office standing in.

sentences.zh: 近世因禘袷則遍祭七祀，其四時則隨時享分祭，攝事以廟卿行禮而服七旒之冕，分太廟牲以為俎，一獻而不薦熟，皆非禮制。

translations.literal: In recent times, because di and xia feasts sacrifice to all seven throughout, while in the four seasons separate seasonal feasts are held, the standing-in official is a temple minister who performs the rite wearing a seven-tassel crown, divides Grand Ancestral Temple victims for the tray, and presents one offering without cooked follow-up — none of this accords with ritual regulations.
translations.idiomatic: In recent times, because di and xia feasts sacrifice to all seven throughout, while in the four seasons separate seasonal feasts are held, the standing-in official is a temple minister who performs the rite wearing a seven-tassel crown, divides Grand Ancestral Temple victims for the tray, and presents one offering without cooked follow-up — none of this accords with ritual regulations.

sentences.zh: 請以立春祭戶於廟室戶外之西，祭司命於廟門之西，制脾於俎；

translations.literal: We request that at the Establishment of Spring sacrifice to the Door outside the west of the temple chamber, sacrifice to the Director of Fate outside the west of the temple gate, and prepare the spleen on the tray;
translations.idiomatic: We ask that at the Establishment of Spring sacrifice to the Door outside the west of the temple chamber, sacrifice to the Director of Fate outside the west of the temple gate, and prepare the spleen on the tray;

sentences.zh: 立夏祭灶於廟門之東，制肺於俎；

translations.literal: At the Establishment of Summer sacrifice to the Stove outside the east of the temple gate, and prepare the lungs on the tray;
translations.idiomatic: At the Establishment of Summer sacrifice to the Stove outside the east of the temple gate, and prepare the lungs on the tray;

sentences.zh: 季夏土王日祭中霤於廟庭之中，制心於俎；

translations.literal: On the earth-sovereign day of late summer sacrifice to the Inner Court in the center of the temple courtyard, and prepare the heart on the tray;
translations.idiomatic: On the earth-sovereign day of late summer sacrifice to the Inner Court in the center of the temple courtyard, and prepare the heart on the tray;

sentences.zh: 立秋祭門及厲於廟門外之西，制肝於俎；

translations.literal: At the Establishment of Autumn sacrifice to the Gate and Plague outside the west of the temple gate, and prepare the liver on the tray;
translations.idiomatic: At the Establishment of Autumn sacrifice to the Gate and Plague outside the west of the temple gate, and prepare the liver on the tray;

sentences.zh: 立冬祭司命及行於廟門外之西，制腎於俎，皆用特牲，更不隨時享分祭。

translations.literal: At the Establishment of Winter sacrifice to the Director of Fate and Travel outside the west of the temple gate, and prepare the kidneys on the tray — all using single victims, and no longer holding separate seasonal feasts.
translations.idiomatic: At the Establishment of Winter sacrifice to the Director of Fate and Travel outside the west of the temple gate, and prepare the kidneys on the tray — all using single victims, and no longer holding separate seasonal feasts.

sentences.zh: 有司攝事，以太廟令攝禮官，服必玄冕，獻必薦熟。

translations.literal: When officials stand in, the Grand Ancestral Temple Director stands in as ritual officer, must wear the dark crown, and must present cooked offerings.
translations.idiomatic: When officials stand in, the Grand Ancestral Temple Director stands in as ritual officer, must wear the dark crown, and must present cooked offerings.

sentences.zh: 親祀及臘享，即依舊禮遍祭之。」

translations.literal: When the emperor sacrifices in person and at la feasts, sacrifice to all according to the old rites."
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor sacrifices in person and at la feasts, sacrifice to all according to the old rites."

sentences.zh: 《政和新儀》定太廟七祀，四時分祭，如元豐儀，臘享袷享則遍祭，設位於殿下橫街之北、道西，東向，北上。

translations.literal: The Political Harmony New Ritual Manual fixed the seven sacrifices of the Grand Ancestral Temple with seasonal division as in the Yuanfeng regulations; at la and xia feasts all were sacrificed to, seats set north of the cross-street below the hall platform, facing east, north taking precedence.
translations.idiomatic: The Political Harmony New Ritual Manual fixed the seven sacrifices of the Grand Ancestral Temple with seasonal division as in the Yuanfeng regulations; at la and xia feasts all were sacrificed to, seats set north of the cross-street below the hall platform, facing east, north taking precedence.

sentences.zh: 馬祖。

translations.literal: Horse Ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: Horse Ancestor.

sentences.zh: 《祀典》：仲春祀馬祖，仲夏享先牧，仲秋祭馬社，仲冬祭馬步，並擇日。

translations.literal: The Sacrificial Canon: in mid-spring sacrifice to the Horse Ancestor, in mid-summer feast the Former Shepherd, in mid-autumn sacrifice to the Horse Community, in mid-winter sacrifice to the Horse Step — all on chosen days.
translations.idiomatic: The Sacrificial Canon: in mid-spring sacrifice to the Horse Ancestor, in mid-summer feast the Former Shepherd, in mid-autumn sacrifice to the Horse Community, in mid-winter sacrifice to the Horse Step — all on chosen days.

sentences.zh: 壇壝之制，三壇各廣九步，高三尺，四陛，一壝。

translations.literal: The altar and enclosure: each of the three altars is nine paces across and three chi high, with four stairways and one enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: The altar and enclosure: each of the three altars is nine paces across and three chi high, with four stairways and one enclosure.

sentences.zh: 又有酺神之祀。

translations.literal: There was also sacrifice to the Pu Spirit.
translations.idiomatic: There was also sacrifice to the Pu Spirit.

sentences.zh: 慶曆中，上封事者言：「螟蝗為害，乞內外並修祭酺。」

translations.literal: During Qingli, a memorialist submitted: "Locusts and caterpillars cause harm — we beg that within and without the court sacrificial pu rites be restored."
translations.idiomatic: During Qingli, a memorialist submitted: "Locusts and caterpillars cause harm — we beg that within and without the court sacrificial pu rites be restored."

sentences.zh: 禮院言：「按《周禮》：'族師，春秋祭酺。

translations.literal: The Ritual Academy submitted: "According to the Rites of Zhou, 'The clan master, in spring and autumn, sacrifices to pu.'
translations.idiomatic: The Ritual Academy reported: "According to the Rites of Zhou, 'The clan master sacrifices to pu in spring and autumn.'

sentences.zh: '酺為人物災害之神。

translations.literal: Pu is the spirit of harm to people and things.
translations.idiomatic: Pu is the spirit of harm to people and things.

sentences.zh: 鄭玄云：'校人職有冬祭馬步。

translations.literal: Zheng Xuan says: 'The Master of Horses' office includes winter sacrifice to the Horse Step.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Xuan says: 'The Master of Horses' office includes winter sacrifice to the Horse Step.

sentences.zh: 則未知此酺者，蝝螟之酺歟，人鬼之步歟？

translations.literal: Then it is unknown whether this pu is the pu of young locusts, or the step of human spirits?
translations.idiomatic: Then it is unknown whether this pu is the pu of young locusts, or the step of human spirits?

sentences.zh: 蓋亦為壇位如雩禜雲。

translations.literal: Probably an altar seat should also be set up as for the rain-prayer and exorcistic rites.'
translations.idiomatic: Probably an altar seat should also be set up as for the rain-prayer and exorcistic rites.'

sentences.zh: '然則校人職有冬步，是與馬為害者，此酺蓋人物之害也。

translations.literal: Yet the Master of Horses' office has the winter step — this concerns harm from horses; this pu is probably harm to people and things.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the Master of Horses' office has the winter step — this concerns harm from horses; this pu is probably harm to people and things.

sentences.zh: 漢有蝝螟之酺神，又有人鬼之步神。

translations.literal: Han had a pu spirit of young locusts, and also a step spirit of human ghosts.
translations.idiomatic: Han had a pu spirit of young locusts, and also a step spirit of human ghosts.

sentences.zh: 歷代書史，悉無祭酺儀式。

translations.literal: Historical books through the generations entirely lack ritual forms for sacrificing to pu.
translations.idiomatic: Historical books through the generations entirely lack ritual forms for sacrificing to pu.

sentences.zh: 欲准祭馬步儀，壇在國城西北，差官就馬壇致祭，稱為酺神。」

translations.literal: It is proposed to follow the Horse Step sacrifice regulations: the altar is northwest of the capital, an official is dispatched to perform sacrifice at the horse altar, and it is called the Pu Spirit."
translations.idiomatic: It was proposed to follow the protocol for the Horse Pace sacrifice: an altar in the northwest of the capital, with officials dispatched to the horse altar to perform the rite under the name Feast God."

sentences.zh: 若外州者，即略依禜禮。

translations.literal: For outer prefectures, follow the exorcistic rite in simplified form.
translations.idiomatic: In outer prefectures, the rite should broadly follow the yong sacrifice protocol.

sentences.zh: 其儀注，先擇便方除地，設營纘為位，營纘謂立表施繩以代壇。

translations.literal: The ritual manual: first choose a convenient site and clear the ground, set up a ritual enclosure as the seat — a ritual enclosure means erecting stakes and stretching cords in place of an altar.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual directions prescribe first selecting a suitable site and clearing the ground, then marking a cord enclosure as the ritual space—erecting a marker and stretching cords in lieu of a built altar.

sentences.zh: 其致齋、行禮、器物，並如小祠。

translations.literal: Purification, performance of the rite, and vessels all follow minor sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: Fasting, performance of the rite, and ritual vessels should all follow small-sacrifice protocol.

sentences.zh: 先祭一日致齋，祭日，設神坐內向，用尊及籩一、豆一，實以酒酺，設于神坐左。

translations.literal: One day before sacrifice enter purification; on the sacrifice day set the spirit seat facing inward, use a wine vessel and one basket and one dish, filled with wine and fermented grain, set to the left of the spirit seat.
translations.idiomatic: The officiant fasts one day before the sacrifice. On the day of the rite, the spirit seat faces inward; a wine vessel, one platter, and one bowl filled with libation wine are placed to the left of the seat.

sentences.zh: 又設罍洗及篚於酒尊之左，俱內向。

translations.literal: Also set a wash basin and basket to the left of the wine vessel, both facing inward.
translations.idiomatic: An urn for washing and a basket are also set to the left of the wine vessel, all facing inward.

sentences.zh: 執事者位於其後，皆以近神為上。

translations.literal: Those performing the rite stand behind them, all taking proximity to the spirit as superior.
translations.idiomatic: Ritual attendants stand behind these objects, with precedence given to those nearest the spirit.

sentences.zh: 薦神用白幣一丈八尺在篚。

translations.literal: For presenting to the spirit use one white silk one zhang and eight chi in the basket.
translations.idiomatic: White silk one zhang and eight chi long is placed in a basket as the offering to the spirit.

sentences.zh: 將祭，贊祀官拜，就盥洗訖，進至神坐前，上香、奠幣。

translations.literal: When about to sacrifice, the assisting sacrificial officer bows, goes to wash hands, then advances before the spirit seat, offers incense and presents silks.
translations.idiomatic: Before the sacrifice, the praising official bows, completes the ablution, advances to the spirit seat, and presents incense and silks.

sentences.zh: 退詣罍盥洗，實以酒，再詣神坐前奠爵，讀祝，再拜，退而瘞幣。

translations.literal: Withdraw, go to the basin to wash hands, fill with wine, again advance before the spirit seat to present the cup, read the invocation, bow twice, withdraw and bury the silks.
translations.idiomatic: He withdraws to the washing urn, fills it with wine, returns to set forth the libation cup before the spirit seat, reads the prayer, performs the double obeisance, withdraws, and buries the silks.

sentences.zh: 其酺神祝文曰：「維年歲次月朔某日，州縣具官某，敢昭告於酺神：蝗蝝薦生，害于嘉穀，惟神降祐，應時消殄。

translations.literal: The invocation text for the Pu Spirit reads: "In the year ___, month ___, day ___, the officials of the prefecture and county ___, respectfully announce to the Pu Spirit: young locusts multiply and harm the fine grain — may the spirit descend and bless, that they be destroyed in season.
translations.idiomatic: The prayer text for the Feast God reads: "On such-and-such year, month, and day of the new moon, the assembled officials of this prefecture and county venture to announce to the Feast God: locust larvae have arisen repeatedly, harming the fine grain. May the spirit descend its blessing and extinguish them in good time.

sentences.zh: 請以清酒、制幣嘉薦，昭告于神，尚享。」

translations.literal: We request to use clear wine and prepared silks as fine offerings, respectfully announcing to the spirit — may it be enjoyed."
translations.idiomatic: We present clear wine and crafted silks as a fine offering and brightly announce this to the spirit. May it partake."

sentences.zh: 紹興祀令：蟲蝗為害，則祭酺神。

translations.literal: The Shaoxing Sacrifice Regulations: when locusts and caterpillars cause harm, sacrifice to the Pu Spirit.
translations.idiomatic: The Shaoxing sacrificial regulations prescribe that when insects and locusts cause harm, the Feast God shall be sacrificed to.

sentences.zh: 嘉定八年六月，以飛蝗入臨安界，詔差官祭告。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the eighth year of Jiading, when flying locusts entered the Lin'an border, an edict dispatched officials to sacrifice and announce.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the eighth year of Jiading, when flying locusts entered the borders of Lin'an, an edict dispatched officials to sacrifice and announce the calamity.

sentences.zh: 又詔兩浙、淮東西路州縣，遇有蝗入境，守臣祭告酺神。

translations.literal: An edict also ordered the prefectures and counties of the Two Zhe, Huaidong, and Huaixi circuits, when locusts entered their borders, that the guarding officials sacrifice and announce to the Pu Spirit.
translations.idiomatic: A further edict directed the prefectures and counties of the two Zhe circuits and the Huaidong and Huaidong West circuits: whenever locusts cross the border, the local officials shall sacrifice and announce to the Feast God.
